passages.title: Ga'nar's Vengeance
passages.text:
My brother's head is as thick as his axe and he is as stubborn as a gronn.

When Ga'nar left he took with him some of the finest warriors in the clan and headed north to the Daggermaw Ravine. If they are still out there, you must find them. Ga'nar will not listen to me.

Help him see his vengeance through if you must but please bring him back to us.

passages.title: Ga'nar's Vengeance
passages.text: So my brother would not dare come himself?

passages.title: On the Trail of Blood
passages.text:
This orc appears to have made a last stand, dying while defending his fallen wolf. His clothes are that of the Frostwolf Clan.

From the tracks and other signs it would appear there were six other wolves during the battle that got away, one bleeding. A trail of fresh blood leads off into the desert northward.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin!
passages.text:
I have no time for my brother's whimpering. We hunt for vengeance or death.

The Thunderlord chieftain slew my father and left me for dead, so I shall take his three sons, the first of which is this runt in my hand.

This filth has revealed the number and positions of the Thunderlords in the ravine beyond.

Join us, if you dare, and you will witness how real warriors of the Frostwolf clan fight. Get in my way, and I will end you.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin!
passages.text:
The Thunderlord think their numbers will save them.

We will show them that their numbers count for nothing when hunted by a pack of Frostwolves.

passages.title: Wrath of Gronn
passages.text:
The Thunderlord are capturing gronn for the Iron Horde. Show these fools why gronn are NOT pets. 

Follow us into Grulloc's Grotto and sunder the chains of the captive gronn. Let the beasts seek to gain their own vengeance against the Thunderlord.

Meet us at Grulloc's Lair beneath the grotto when you are done.

passages.title: Wrath of Gronn
passages.text: For many years I hunted all sorts of prey alongside my father. This hunt shall honor his memory as well as avenge his death at the hands of these traitorous, honorless Thunderlords.

passages.title: The Eldest
passages.text:
There is Hatock, last and eldest son of the Iron Wolf. One of the greatest hunters the Thunderlord have ever fielded.

He was there when his father murdered my father and left me for dead.

When I am done with him he will regret not finishing the job.

passages.title: The Eldest
passages.text: Today is a good day.

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text:
Even when on a mission of vengeance we must remember to uphold the honor that is required of a member of the Frostwolves.

In the grotto below are the fallen corpses of many good Frostwolf orcs. They must be remembered.

While you carry out Ga'nar's task, look for articles of our fallen brethren. Bring these articles to me so that I might pass them to a shaman for final burial as is our tradition.

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text: Have you found the articles?

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text: You have shown honor to our clan. This act shall be remembered.

passages.title: Kyle Currency Test Quest
They Rely on Numbers
passages.text:
Thunderlord spend their days training to hunt as a team, but as individuals they are weak. Their only strength is in numbers.

So... to win, we must cull their numbers.

As we move up through the Daggermaw Ravine, slay any Thunderlord who stand in your way, and their clan will be made the weaker for it.

passages.title: They Rely on Numbers
passages.text: My axe bears the blood of a dozen Thunderlord. How many have you slain this day?

passages.title: They Rely on Numbers
passages.text: A fine headcount, commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
passages.text:
Draka and Drek'Thar are travelling to Farseer's Rock. It is a sacred place, not a safe one. But Draka insists that Drek'Thar must rebuild his connection to the elements.

I can feel the spirits of this land are becoming restless. Something is about to happen, and I suspect these two will need all the help they can get.

Please, adventurer, go to them and lend what aid you can. I care for these two a great deal.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
passages.text: You again? Not eaten by ogres or killed by Thunderlords yet? Ha!

passages.title: Eaters of the Elements
passages.text:
Drek'Thar has already begun his ritual, and it is powerful enough to draw the attention of the local goren. Those beasts are drawn to elemental magic like flies to a corpse.

I will have my hands full soon enough. Help us if you like but Drek'Thar must be allowed to finish his ritual.

passages.title: Eaters of the Elements
passages.text:
I came seeking aid from the elements. I see now that we are the ones who must aid them.

Come, <name>, witness what I have witnessed.

passages.title: Scavengers of Flame
passages.text:
I sense another child of the fury being consumed by the vile goren in a nearby nest.

Search the caves east of here for any signs of a goren nest. I suspect there will be quite alot of steam given the cold.

I will try to locate the next child of the fury in your absence.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text:
The goren and the magnaron are ravaging the element spirits and smelting their essence as one would smelt steel.

Commander, take my totem, travel east to Magnarok. Please, find them, and free them.

Draka and I will make our way to the Ascent of Frostfire. Meet us there if you are successful.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text: The ritual was more draining than I could have anticipated.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text:
You have done well, <class>.

We will need the aid of these children when the time comes to rescue Exurotus.

passages.title: The Ascent
passages.text:
I can feel the voice of the Fury at the top of the ascent. Come, let us climb these stairs together.

Be on your guard. The goren of this area are likely to be drawn by the smell of a shaman.

If we get separated, fall back to the base of the stairs and regroup.

passages.title: The Ascent
passages.text: This is ancient magic, from a time before the orcs. It will not be easy to undo.

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text:
The moment I begin the ritual to free Exurotus you can expect Kron to be drawn to us. 

It would normally take an army of seasoned warriors to defeat a magnaron. We have only the three of us.

Look for my fire totem upon the battlefield. I will try to gain what boons I can from Exurotus. Step near the totems and become one with the Fury.

With these boons, slay Kron! Lok'tar ogar!

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text: The... Fury... is nearly free!

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text:
With Kron defeated I can finish breaching the magic that holds Exurotus, but I may be too late. So much of the fury has already been expended and drained by the magnaron and goren.

I fear we may have only bought this spirit a peaceful death.

passages.title: Securing the South
passages.text:
We have an outpost to the southeast that was boxed in by Thunderlord forces as they marched through the canyons to Wor'gol.

I have sent reinforcements to secure the outpost and press east to Grom'gar. We will push the Thunderlords out of our lands completely, and pursue them all the way back to that reeking corpse they call home.

Draka's sister, Lokra, was among the orcs who volunteered to clean up Stonefang Outpost.

passages.title: Securing the South
passages.text: <name>! They told me you'd be heading this way. You are late to the party! We are just cleaning up now.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text:
The siege has been broken - they underestimated the resilience of Stonefang, and our reinforcement wave from Bladespire caught them completely off-guard.

Once we finish cleaning up here, we rally anyone who can still fight and prepare to march for Grom'gar.

The outpost captain, Karg Bloodfury, should have come out to meet us by now. Can you get him out here?

Tell him Lokra is waiting. He knows how much I hate to be kept waiting.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text: You go ahead - Asha and I will hold here for now.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text: You're back! But where is Karg?

passages.title: Into the Boneslag
passages.text:
The Thunderlords took prisoners into the Boneslag?

Well what are we waiting for?! We have to go after them!

You look for the missing villagers - Asha and I will track Karg.

passages.title: Into the Boneslag
passages.text: Thank you for finding the others. Karg and his captor are one step ahead of us, but they're limping.

passages.title: Moving Target
passages.text:
Karg's captors are moving east - probably retreating to Grom'gar with their tails between their legs!

They think they outrun me, but Asha here is the fastest thing on four legs. We'll run them down in the Icewind Drifts.

passages.title: Moving Target
passages.text:
<Lokra's gaze remains fixed on her dying frost wolf.>

We had them... We had them, Asha. You were so fast. So beautiful.

I failed you, Asha. I am sorry.

passages.title: The Strength of Our Bonds
passages.text:
Asha has passed, but we share a bond that cannot be severed by death. Even now, her spirit urges me onward to Grom'gar.

The Iron Wolf claims our attachments make us weak... that love makes us vulnerable.

He is wrong.

Karg is my strength, and I his. I will free him from his chains, and together we will show the Thunderlord clan the strength of our bonds.

passages.title: The Strength of Our Bonds
passages.text: Help me out of these chains. We have work to do.

passages.title: To Karabor!
passages.text:
Draenor will not be a friendly place for someone like you. There are far too many orcs here, and I know your kind has a history with the orcs.

No, if you're looking for a friendly face here on Draenor, you'll need to find the draenei.

Hop on my back. I will take you to the draenei temple of Karabor.

passages.title: Collect Karabor Axes
passages.text:
Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.

To make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. 

The idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.

<name>, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?

passages.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
passages.text:
Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.

He has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

passages.title: Catching His Eye
passages.text:
For what must be done, I need someone I can trust. You're one of those few.

The woods and the orc village, Gul'var, are protected from my scrying magic. We need to pierce that veil. I think I know a way.

There's a fel presence within the woods. A demonic watcher is there, hidden in a cave from which it casts its all-seeing gaze.

I would like for you and the warden to capture it.

passages.title: Catching His Eye
passages.text:
As soon as we have enough blessed water from the priestess's moonwell, we'll break the demon's will and use it as a proxy to see into Gul'var.

That way, they won't know it's us scrying upon them.

But first, we need to weaken their shrouding magic.

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text:
It's good to know what Teron'gor and Cho'gall are up to. It's more important that we stop Gul'dan.

Some of his disciples can summon minor demons. To do this, these lesser warlocks must use a soul shard. The foul crystal creates a connection to the Twisting Nether, pulling a demon through against its will.

Gul'dan's as much demon as he is orc. If we can gather some of the more potent shards, we can combine them into something that just might capture him.

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text: Do you have the shards, <name>?

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text:
Now all that's left to do is to fashion them together into something strong enough to ensnare Gul'dan.

Luckily, we can do that right here.

passages.title: Task: Warsong Riot
passages.text: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!

passages.title: Think of the Children!
passages.text:
When the Shadowmoon attacked Arbor Glen, everything was thrown into chaos.

Many of us escaped, but there are still three children missing.

I believe they are still back in the village.

Please save them!

passages.title: Think of the Children!
passages.text: I am glad to hear that the children are safe. They will remember your heroic deeds for their entire lives.

passages.title: Into Twilight
passages.text:
The safety of my people is of the utmost priority.

It is likely that Ner'zhul has taken the prisoners to Shaz'gul, his stronghold to the southwest.

I do not wish to use aggression against him, but he may force my hand.

Meet me at Twilight Glade, <name>. Then, we shall try our best to recover the prisoners.

passages.title: Into Twilight
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>. There is much to be done.

passages.title: The Memory of Fire
passages.text:
<The obsidian chip is hot to the touch, but strangely, can be held with no fear of being burned.>

On its surface is etched a picture - a rectangular stone with a hole cut through the middle, surrounded by a ring of flames.

There is just such a stone in the fields to the north.

passages.title: A Hero's Welcome
passages.text:
Prophet Velen has asked me to show you around Shadowmoon Valley.

We will go first to Embaari Village, where my sister Samaara is waiting for us. I have not seen her since the Iron Horde took me to Tanaan.

The village is just one of many trading villages between the Temple of Karabor and Shattrath.

Follow the road east and make your way to Embaari Village. I will accompany you, my friend.

passages.title: A Hero's Welcome
passages.text:
Thank you, stranger! The Prophet spoke of new allies arriving on our shores.

I hear it is thanks to you that my sister is safe.

I owe you a great debt, friend.

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text:
Oh my, such a vigorous young <lad/lass>! Such a spring in your step, and such a sparkle in your eye!

When you get to my age, it's all aches and pains.

Luckily, I have a recipe for an unguent that would soothe my joints. I just need the ooze from the skin of belly toads in the swamp.

Would you be a dear and help an old woman out?

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text: It's all downhill from here, dearie.

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text:
Oh thank you child, thank you, thank you.

The nights in the swamp are cold. It means a lot to this old woman to have some comfort from her aching bones.

passages.title: The Demons Among Us - Alliance
passages.text:
Now that we have the cloth and leather, we can craft a fitting disguise for our infiltration mission.

Go speak to Ginni Gingerlips. She has proven herself quite capable in the realm of... errr... garment design.

passages.title: Escape From Shaz'gul
passages.text:
I've failed, <name>...

My squadron was caught by a wandering patrol. We fought fiercely, but the alarm had been raised. The rangari forced me into hiding before surrendering themselves to the enemy.

They were under MY command, and they gave their lives... for what? I... I'm not sure what to do, <name>.

We need to get out of here, but how?

passages.title: Escape From Shaz'gul
passages.text:
I could never have done it without you, <name>. Your words unlocked something within me which I have not felt before.

Call it what you wish - resolve, conviction, faith. I will not soon forget this, <class>.

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text:
Ey commander, fancy runnin' inta ya out here!

Tha garrison's got plenty a hungry mouths ta feed, with more folks comin' by every day.

We're really gonna need a big haul o' meat ta keep everyone happy.

Wouldya care ta lend us a hand? It'll be faster work with an extra pair a hands.

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text: Have ya seen tha size a these beasts?

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text:
Brilliant, just brilliant! Ay've never seen such a haul in my entire life!

Get tha wagons ready. We're eatin' well tonight!

passages.title: Fallen From the Stars
passages.text:
The final ingredient is a rare flower that grows only in the heart of the Nightmarsh.

This flower feeds only on starlight, and dies when it falls under shadow.

If you can find such a flower, bring it to me. Only its essence will help me gain the clarity I need.

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text:
The ancients of the Cursed Woods have been corrupted by demonic magic. Since they need to be destroyed, we might as well make use of their resources. Waste not, want not.

Beware: these woodland behemoths are no easy targets. Gather trusted friends before you engage these twisted ancients.

-- Baros Alexston

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text: Have you read the bounty I posted concerning the twisted ancients in the Cursed Woods?

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text:
Unfortunate that the ancient guardians of the woods fell to such corruption.

At least now, its long nightmare has ended. Not to mention its sacrifice is our gain.

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text:
The archmage has asked me to prepare this moonwell. Once it is completed, I'll be able to sanctify its water for use against the demon.

Only one thing remains.

A piece of one of Draenor's moons has fallen into a nearby pool on the far side of the woods. Such a thing is perfect for use in the dedication of the moonwell to Elune.

Will you bring it back for me, <name>?

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text: With that chunk of fallen rock, I'll be able to complete the dedication of the moonwell.

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. The White Lady will be pleased.

Now, I shall go about the business of preparing the moonwell water for use in the archmage's plan.

But first, I wonder if you'd be willing to help me again. The warden brought back very disturbing stories about the creatures in the woods.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text:
The fiery heart of Krosnis is in the forge. We have the soul shards.

Now all that is left to do is to stoke the fires and combine all of these foul components into a trap for Gul'dan.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text: With the soul shards combined, we will trap Gul'dan and put an end to the Shadow Council on Draenor.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text:
You've forged the soul trap. There's no time to waste, <name>.

We must capture Gul'dan.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text:
Long ago, the shaman of the Shadowmoon clan erected three stones in the woods. There, they performed their sacred rituals, blessing the beasts and the trees.

Now, someone has placed a fel magic upon those stones. This corruption is what shrouds the village of Gul'var.

Before we can use the captured demon to safely peer into the Shadow Council's village, we must bring down those stones.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text: Once the shrouding stones are destroyed, we'll turn our attention to breaking this demon's will.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text:
Now that the veil has been lifted from the woods, we can make use of the demon.

We will convince it to turn its eye upon Gul'var and show us what the Shadow Council is planning.

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text:
We have their citadel, but they still have some of my people enslaved at the Sootstained Mines.

We have no one to spare, but you seem more than capable of handling a few ogres on your own.

I ask that you release any enslaved Frostwolves you find there, and keep an eye out for Mulverick.

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text: Free my people and then we can talk!

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text: Who are you, outsider? I saw you freeing some of my kin...

passages.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
passages.text:
Cordana tells me that the creatures of the woods are cursed by the same fel energies keeping Khadgar from scrying into the orc village.

This will not do.

If we were on Azeroth, I could find a cure in a reasonable timeframe. However, we are not, nor do we have the luxury of time.

Better to put a swift end to their suffering rather than allow these poor creatures to linger with demonic energy.

passages.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
passages.text:
Grim business. I wish that it could have gone differently.

Thank you for your dedication, <name>. Be comforted in the fact that Elune understands.

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text:
The ogres outnumbered us, *cough* but we made them pay for their deeds in blood.

Even so, I was forced to abandon my fallen brothers and sisters on the battlefield. They deserve better than to have their corpses despoiled by the ogre filth.

Here, take this torch *cough* and do what I could not: burn the corpses of my fallen brothers and sisters to the west.

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text: Did you give the others a proper burial?

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text: You bring honor to the clan by giving my family a proper burial, <name>.

passages.title: Task: Clear Out Grimfrost Hill.
passages.text: Kill Grimfrost Ogres

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
passages.text:
Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.

He has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text:
Snowpaw was able to help me to here so that I might strike against their leader, Guttra, but I have lost too much blood. My time is near.

Do you have the strength to help me avenge my fallen brothers and sisters and kill Guttra Wolfchew?

The monster resides in the tallest tower of Grimfrost.

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text: Did you kill Guttra Wolfchew?

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text: Wolfchew is defeated? *cough* Glorious.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
passages.text:
Just because we need to focus on Gul'dan doesn't mean we're not going to take down the Shadow Council in the process.

This village is filthy with Shadow Council villains. Let's do something about them.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
passages.text: Every world is better off without those demon-loving scum.

passages.title: Grimfrost Hill
passages.text: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

passages.title: Missing Hunting Party
passages.text: xxxxxxx

passages.title: Blackrock Down
passages.text:
Hey <name>, just the <race> I was hopin' to see. I just received a distress call from Thaelin.

He and Romuul left a while ago to do some reconnaissance on another one of those draenei crystals, but now it sounds like they're in wee a spot o' trouble.

Knowing Thaelin, he's going to need some help.

passages.title: Fight for Freedom
passages.text:
The Iron Horde keeps us here against our will. They control us with fear and aggression.

It pains me to see my people subjugated like this.

All we need to stand up to these beasts is hope... and a large weapon.

passages.title: Heart On Fire
passages.text:
We have the shards, but now they must be combined. There's a forge here, but even its fires aren't hot enough for our purposes.

However, there is a demon nearby that burns hot as the sun.

Gul'dan, or perhaps Razuun, has managed to summon an infernal. The thing calls itself Krosnis, which means "furnace."

The demon's heart burns hotly enough. All you need do is collect it.

passages.title: Heart On Fire
passages.text: With the combined might of the shards, we should be able to trap Gul'dan.

passages.title: Heart On Fire
passages.text: Quickly, place the heart in the forge. We'll use its infernal heat to forge the trap.

passages.title: To the Defense of Karabor
passages.text: Get your bad self to Karabor, you <class>y little <race>-muffin.

passages.title: The Defense of Karabor
passages.text:
Defend Karabor from the Iron Horde.

At the end of the northern courtyard is Arnokk the Burner. He guards the entrance to the harbor behind Karabor, where the main Iron Horde army is waiting.

Once we've taken care of him, we'll need to deal with the Iron Horde leader, Commander Vorka.

passages.title: The Defense of Karabor
passages.text:
We did it, <name>. Without your heroic efforts, the Temple of Karabor would have been lost to the Iron Horde.

Prophet Velen would be proud of us.

passages.title: Gloomshade Grove
passages.text:
<This looks like one of the pack mules from your garrison. It's strange that it's wandering out here alone.

You probably should investigate.>

passages.title: Gloomshade Grove
passages.text: <The mule looks frightened.>

passages.title: Gloomshade Grove
passages.text: Thank the Light. <Cough> I didn't think I would get out of here alive.

passages.title: A Proper Burial
passages.text:
<The orc is visibly winded. A large pool of blood is gathering at his feet.>

We were out hunting when we found the wolves under attack.

Many ogres were slaughtered by our blades... but their numbers were too great.

I'm going to catch my breath before I go out and kill the rest of them.

Here, take this torch. Go give my brothers and sister a proper burial and return to me.

passages.title: The Friendly Foreling
passages.text:
You saved us! You my best friend.

<The forling gives you a big hug.>

You so nice best friend. You smell so good. The other friends eat your friends. So sad. They are so not good friends.

I know where more friends are! You need friends? My friends take my things. I need things back before I can be chief. Things make me strong.

<The foreling looks at you longingly. Then it sniffs you>

Follow me best friend, we find all the friends, and all the things.

passages.title: [Deprecated]
passages.text: The blood soaked body of Kenny is slummped up against the cave wall. The podlings clearly made a feast of him.

passages.title: Collect Moonstones
passages.text:
We need moonstones. Foreling friends LOVE moonstones. moonstones best gift since foods. Foods soooo good. Best friend loves foods? Of course best friend loves foods.

If we have all the moonstones, foreling friends love us, maybe give us ALL the foods. Maybe if we have so many moonstones foreling friends make me chief. Imagine...

<The forling looks into the woods and smacks it's lips.>

We find all the moonstones.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
passages.text:
Khadgar wants you to concentrate on Gul'dan, but that doesn't mean we're not going to take down the Shadow Council in the process.

Gul'var's filthy with Shadow Council villains. Let's do something about them.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
passages.text: Every world is better off without those demon-loving scum.

passages.title: Task: Trapped Critters
passages.text: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

passages.title: Captured Critters
passages.text: This poor critter is about to be podling food. It would be pretty easy to set this little guy free.

passages.title: Armed and Dangerous
passages.text:
Ligra was sent with extra weapons to equip enslaved Frostwolves.

Arm the Frostwolf Slaves so they can cut their way from their slavers.

passages.title: Armed and Dangerous
passages.text: The ogres appear to be in disarray and many of my people are now free.

passages.title: Become Chief
passages.text: xxxxxxx

passages.title: Tracking Event: Chief killed
passages.text:
Okay best friend. Let's talk to old smelly mud chief. We smell so good like moonstone and foods. We give friends moonstones. We tell friends I'm chief. We get ALL the foods.

Stupid bad smelling chief. Thinks I'm foods? Pshh. He's foods.

Time for foods best friend.

passages.title: Meet Us at Starfall Outpost
passages.text:
The archmage has uncovered a potential Shadow Council presence in the valley. He asked me to let you know.

As soon as you can, join us at Starfall Outpost. We're going to need your muscle to root them out, commander.

passages.title: Meet Us at Starfall Outpost
passages.text:
Hello again, <name>. You're just in time.

We've tracked the Shadow Council to a nearby village. I suspect that Gul'dan is with them.

passages.title: REUSE
Death of a Tyrant
passages.text:
It is good to see you survived the assault. The fortress is nearly ours!

Ga'nar and Durotan cleared the way to Gorr'thog's chamber while you were freeing our wolves. Korga and I will make sure no ogres follow you up.

<name>, Gorr'thog is a mighty warrior. Hurry to them before it is too late!

passages.title: Speak to Thrall
General Problems
Torg's Trouble
Verick's Vindicators
REUSE
Great Balls of Fire!
passages.text:
Ga'nar led Ligra and the others to the second level of the fortress. Your friend, Thrall, also went to lend his skills.

Follow the ramp on the south end of the ramparts outside to join them.

Help them bring victory to the Frostwolf Clan!

passages.title: Great Balls of Fire!
passages.text: Yes, traveler?

passages.title: Great Balls of Fire!
passages.text: Many were killed or wounded on their way here.

passages.title: Elwynn Run
passages.text:
Welcome to the Ironelf games! For this challenge: get to the blue marker, then the green marker, then return here.

Score is based on your time, so get back as fast as you can!

passages.title: The Butcher of Bladespire
passages.text:
After Ga'nar advanced into the fortress, the Bladespire unleashed a giant creature on our forces.

I am still weak after using my magic, but at least I can help this orc in her recovery.

Help take Dorogg down, <name>.

passages.title: The Butcher of Bladespire
passages.text: Have Dorogg fallen?

passages.title: The Butcher of Bladespire
passages.text: This room shook when the monster fell. Your deeds shall not go unremembered.

passages.title: Mopping Up
passages.text:
We've won the day, but our work here is far from finished.

Frostwolves will scour the citadel and root out any survivors. To you, I offer the glory of cleansing the gladiator pits to the north.

As we launched our attack, we dispatched one of our best to recon that area. If you still thirst for blood, join her there. There's surely some sport left.

passages.title: Mopping Up
passages.text:
<Igrimar winces as you show her Durotan's orders.>

Don't look at me like that... ungh... I've survived worse.

passages.title: A Matter of Life and Death
passages.text:
Stranger, please help me!

My companions and I ventured here to seek the bounty on a monstrous wasp queen.

After we set up camp down the hill, we fell asleep. We were attacked in the middle of the night by these horrid, pale... things!

I don't know where my friends have gone, but I heard screams from further down the cavern.

Please, find my companions. I can't leave here without them!

passages.title: A Matter of Life and Death
passages.text: They told us not to come out here, but we didn't listen. Why didn't we listen!?

passages.title: A Matter of Life and Death
passages.text: My prayers have been answered, hero. I will tell everyone back at the village of your deeds.

passages.title: Northshire Dash 12
passages.text:
For this challenge: run through the arch, then get to the blue marker and return here as fast as you can.

Get back before you hear the bell toll 12 times.

passages.title: Ours is the Fury
passages.text:
Drek'Thar will be fine, once he adjusts. The vision the elemental has bestowed upon him is powerful, and he is on the path of becoming this world's greatest shaman.

You may wish to inform Warmaster Zog in your garrison of what has transpired here.

He should be able to deploy some of your troops to the area to further secure the area.

passages.title: Ours is the Fury
passages.text: Well done, commander. I shall see what forces we can dispatch to the area for further clean-up.

passages.title: Eatercology
passages.text:
Drek'Thar thinks the portions of Exurotus consumed by the goren might be worthless. I am not about to step before the fury without at least trying to recover as many of these "motes" as possible.

Slay any goren you find at Magnarok and see if you can extract the motes of Frostfire from them.

passages.title: Eatercology
passages.text: Have you had any luck recovering those motes?

passages.title: Eatercology
passages.text: Goren are abominations. They were created to eat the world. Your have done well.

passages.title: Northwestern Medicine
passages.text:
There is an herb which grows in the crevices and crags of Frostfire Ridge, in places where the icy breath of the sky sips the boiling blood of the earth. Thunderlord climbers gather it often, for it has potent healing properties.

Look for stores of these herbs in Thunderfall, and take what you can. Give them to me when next we meet, and they can be used to save lives in Stonefang.

passages.title: The Cure
passages.text:
Cowards! A curse on these wretched meatbags!

The Bladespire have always taunted the orc clans by taking our wounded as slaves to fight like dogs in their pits.

In retaliation for our assault they have poisoned their orc prisoners, leaving them to suffer and die an excruciating death.

Only their geomancers carry the antidote, traveler. Use it to cure the Frostwolf prisoners.

passages.title: The Cure
passages.text: You have done the Frostwolf Clan a service, traveler. I shall be sure to tell Durotan of your deeds.

passages.title: Gloomshade Game Hunter
passages.text:
<You find a list on a piece of parchment.

Arsenio needs some ingredients for a new recipe he's preparing at your garrison.>

passages.title: Gloomshade Game Hunter
passages.text: Did you find all the ingredients I need?

passages.title: Gloomshade Game Hunter
passages.text: Nice! Thanks so much! I can use these to make a delicious wolf meat, frog leg, mushroom stew.

passages.title: The Iron Tide
passages.text:
The majority of Karabor's defensive troops are dealing with the main battle front, just west of here. We must not ignore our flanks while dealing with that assault.

One of the enemy leaders, Arnokk, is directing the mayhem on this side of the temple. Take him out, along with as many of his orcish followers as you can stomach.

Once you've finished, meet me in front of the temple.

passages.title: From Over the Walls
passages.text:
Karabor is falling. The Iron Horde will not stop this assault until every last one of us is dead and cold on the ground.

I don't know about you, but I don't plan on letting that happen.

Now, there must be something we can do to prevent them from scaling the walls...

passages.title: Rally the Artificers
passages.text:
I have several lieutenants out there on the battlefield, doing what they can to hold this temple together. I need all of them, but first and foremost, I need my artificers.

The artificers are masters of technology and artifacts. If any one of my followers can understand the mechanics of those siege engines, it would be them.

Rommul is their leader. Send him to me.

passages.title: The Fall of the Warlord
passages.text:
You've managed to survive this long, stranger. All that remains to be done here is to fell the Warlord of the arena.

This will be your first true test here. Bult would provide a challenge to even a battle-hardened Frostwolf.

Place the heads you've collected on spikes in the Frostfire Arena. They are sure to enrage the warlord and lure him into battle.

Come out of the arena victorious and it will show that Durotan's trust in you was not misplaced.

passages.title: The Fall of the Warlord
passages.text: Yes, traveler?

passages.title: The Fall of the Warlord
passages.text: Impressive work.

passages.title: Save Wolf Home
passages.text:
Cowardly Thunderlords...

During the battle for the citadel, runners informed me that the Iron Wolf is striking at our home. He'll find no easy footing there, Draka will make them pay tenfold for any of ours that they slay, but we must return quickly and chase the mongrels off.

You and your forces have proven valuable allies of the Frostwolves. We'd welcome your aid in securing our Wor'gol.

I'll see you on the battlefield if you choose to come.

passages.title: Save Wolf Home
passages.text: There are more Thunderlord to be killed.

passages.title: Save Wolf Home
passages.text: Durotan's trust in you is well-placed, <name>. You have mine as well.

passages.title: The Farseer
passages.text:
The Thunderlord warleader... <name>, you have to stop him.

He went to attack Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions to the northwest!

passages.title: The Farseer
passages.text: Wolf Home will not be safe until this coward is dead!

passages.title: The Farseer
passages.text: Wolf Home is saved, but I sense a stronger enemy just over the horizon.

passages.title: Back to Bladespire Citadel
passages.text:
Durotan must be told of your vision. Pul Windcarver will offer you a flight back.

The fate of the Frostwolf... of Draenor, depends upon you, <name>.

passages.title: Back to Bladespire Citadel
passages.text:
Grim news indeed, <name>.

For saving Wolf Home, I would name you wolf-brother.

Now we must defend Frostfire Ridge from the Thunderlord clan and the Iron Horde.

passages.title: The Slavemaster's Demise
passages.text: Share word with the others of the Frostwolves you saved this day. They will be glad to know that some made it out of the mines alive.

passages.title: The Slavemaster's Demise
passages.text:
You found Mulverick?

It shouldn't be long before those ogres clear out after you defeated their master.

passages.title: Return to the Pack
passages.text:
Part of me agrees with Karg - we COULD challenge the Iron Wolf right now. My fists clench at the mention of his name. My muscles scream for vengeance.

But then, in my heart, I feel Asha. Calming me. Guiding me. I do not deserve her wisdom, but it is a gift I will not waste.

<Lokra squints at the sky.>

Durotan and the others will be gathering at your garrison about now. We should meet them.

passages.title: Return to the Pack
passages.text:
Lokra has always lacked the patience and control of her older sister. She approaches problems head-first, and relies on her raw talents to succeed.

Seeing the way her and Karg look at each other, I am not surprised she chased him all the way to Grom'gar. What surprises me is that they made it back.

As usual, I expect we have you to thank for that. You continue to honor us with your deeds.

passages.title: Unexpected Assault
passages.text:
Thank the Light you're here. The Bonechewer orcs have invaded!

We've dealt with the occasional raid before, but they've never attacked Auchindoun with such numbers before.

We arrived as quickly as we could to respond to the threat, but the local guard had already fallen. We cannot afford to lose more men!

Kill all of the Bonechewer you can and help consolidate our forces back to our defensive line. The Bonechewer must not be allowed to step foot in Auchindoun!

passages.title: Unexpected Assault
passages.text:
My scouts have reported that the Bonechewer clan is attacking Auchindoun, <name>. The Auchenai guard are here, but I fear they won't be enough.

I sense a dark presence nearby... we cannot chance leaving their defenses weak. Too much power lies within those hallowed halls.

Slay the Bonechewer and direct any of the Auchenai injured back to their defensive line. I will direct my scouts throughout the area to try to ascertain the Bonechewers' motives.

passages.title: Blackthorn's Lieutenants
passages.text:
Amnennar's reincarnation is imminent. In order to protect the ceremony Death Speaker Blackthorn has placed his most trusted lieutenants between us and him.

Aarux, a plagued spider nests near his young, tended to by the Death's Head Aranomancers. Mordresh rallies Amnennar's forces upon the Bone Pile. Finally, Mushlump stands guarding the entrance to the Spiral of Thorns.

Once you defeat these guardians I will join you and together we will confront Blackthorn.

passages.title: Blackthorn's Lieutenants
passages.text: Have you cleared the way?

passages.title: Blackthorn's Lieutenants
passages.text: You have done well, but this is only half of the battle. With his support structure in disarray it is time to strike at Death Speaker Blackthorn.

passages.title: Un-Safety First
passages.text: These plans were designed to be read by even the most unskilled of metallurgists. It has big symbols on specific pipes for what valves NOT to turn unless risking woeful amounts of destruction.

passages.title: Save Auchenai Caretakers
passages.text:
I was fortunate enough to be delivering a report to the Exarch when the demons attacked, but the rest of my brethren were out tending to the Court of Lights!

We caretakers are not the fighters of our order. Go to the court northwest of here and help direct them to safety.

passages.title: These Colors Don't Run
passages.text:
Bladespire has been a plague on my people for many years.

That ends today!

Now to explain it to the ogres in a way they will understand.

If you still wish to help us, place our banner in the corpses of our adversaries. 

Their courage will falter as they behold a field of Frostwolf trophies!

This is our way. I will meet with you ahead when you have completed this deed.

passages.title: These Colors Don't Run
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: These Colors Don't Run
passages.text: These are no ordinary enemies, yet you did not show any signs of weakness.

passages.title: Last Steps
passages.text:
In a rage, Ga'nar ascended to fight Gorr'thog, the ogre king.

He is alone, and the ramp to the throne room is now blocked.

You've proven resourceful. Perhaps you could find another way up?

I sustained wounds on my way here, but I will work to cut my way through and up the ramp so we may rejoin.

Hurry traveler, ensure that the Frostwolf clan wins our assault on the citadel.

passages.title: Last Steps
passages.text: We called you outsider, <race>, but you have shown the strength and heart of a Frostwolf.

passages.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
passages.text:
In the tomb... horrible... bodies everywhere...

A dark ritual... please... you must stop it...

passages.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
passages.text:
Down there... horrible... bodies everywhere...

Dark ritual... please... you must stop it...

passages.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
passages.text:
If this Teron'gor gains control of Auchindoun, the results would be catastrophic!

We must stop him before his power grows!

passages.title: Find D'kaan
passages.text:
D'kaan's nearby. He said something about unusual tracks. Hardly what we need to be focusing on at a time like this.

We need to leave soon. Help him, would you?

passages.title: The Element of Demise
passages.text:
The Frostwolves are a fierce and noble clan, but distrustful of outsiders.

We have arrived amidst their assault on a mighty ogre citadel. I will remain here to offer counsel to their chieftain, Durotan.

You are a proven hero of Azeroth, <name>. Demonstrate your value to the Frostwolves. We need them as allies.

Use my totem to thwart the ogre counterattack. This should serve to get their attention.

The rest is up to you.

passages.title: The Laughing Skull
passages.text:
Ah, adventurer, good. I need someone who is not of my clan to negotiate with the Laughing Skull.

We could use their help navigating this land, but they are dangerous and unpredictable, much like Gorgrond itself.

Follow this road and seek out someone willing to speak with you.

Perhaps they will see you as something new and be willing to talk first and stab later.

passages.title: The Laughing Skull
passages.text: Ha! Curious. What are you?

passages.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
passages.text:
We... we left the goren alone for too long. They have grown bold and forgotten who we are.

Kill them! Kill them all. Rip them apart until they scream. Remind them what happens to anyone who tries to attack a Laughing Skull village.

Oh, and welcome to Gorgrond.

passages.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
passages.text: Ripfist's dying wish has been satisfied. Goren corpses litter the ground, and these corpses have not gone unnoticed by the nearby goren.

passages.title: Arkonite Crystals
Desperate Times
The Cost of Chaos
Muddy Waters
passages.text:
<Cough>

Not feeling so strong... dehydrated...

<Cough>

Need nutrients for leaves... need revenge...

passages.title: Light's Rest
passages.text:
This map you found seems to show the locations of the other portals. By the Light, they have it surrounded!

We have a small staging area not far from the nearest portal. Let's go.

NYI. Cheat this quest and go to the camp.

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text:
Aruuna, a draenei mining settlement to the northeast, has been sacked. Strangely, it doesn't sound like the work of the Iron Horde.

My scouts describe the attackers as "giant fire-breathing birdmen."

I suppose nothing in this place should surprise me anymore...

<QUESTGIVER points to her map.>

Refugees have been seen fleeing along this road. Help them if possible, and learn whatever you can about the attackers.

if these "birdmen" are a threat, we need to know.

passages.title: Pyrophobia
passages.text:
W- we have done n-n-nothing to provoke the arakkoa... w-why would they attack Aruuna? What do they want from us?

I want to run, but I'm... too afraid. That leader of theirs will burn me to a crisp, I just know it!

H-he's just inside the inn...

passages.title: Pyrophobia
passages.text: SHH! K-k-keep your voice down... they'll find us!

passages.title: Pyrophobia
passages.text:
You killed him? Oh, oh thank you!

But what was that he said about an artifact?

passages.title: What the Draenei Found
passages.text:
They came here for an artifact? The miners must have found something in our crystal mine to the north.

By the Light, can you imagine how powerful that thing must be, to attract them all the way here from their spires?

I suppose it is in their hands now... You'd have to be crazy to go looking for it...

passages.title: What the Draenei Found
passages.text:
I was worried my little act wouldn't fool you, but you played your role perfectly.

In fact, I would like to ask for your help again.

passages.title: The Purge of Veil Shadar
passages.text:
Not all arakkoa are alike.

<Iskar lifts his sleeve to reveal a mangled, useless wing.>

It is no illusion. They did this to me. Before I was even given a name, I was given a place in society: at the bottom.

We are many. We make our homes in the places this world has forgotten.

Veil Shadar was such a place, but the Adherents have found it and started a purge. For morale. For fun.

Help my people escape, and we'll be in your debt.

When the sky burns, it pays to have allies in the shadows.

passages.title: The Purge of Veil Shadar
passages.text: Mark my words, <race>: Aruuna and Veil Shadar were only the beginning.

passages.title: Forbidden Knowledge
passages.text:
<Darkscryer Raastok narrows his eyes and looks you up and down.>

So, you are Iskar's hired hand? Well, I care not whether you are |5<race> or an overgrown moth, so long as you are willing to help.

The Adherents of Rukhmar are closed-minded fools! They forbid the study of shadow magic, branding as heretics anyone who dares to seek answers in the dark.

We kept many tomes of forbidden knowledge in Veil Shadar. Bring any you find to me, and I will reward you for keeping them from the flames.

passages.title: Forbidden Knowledge
passages.text: What kind of sick individual burns a book full of perfectly good dark arts?!

passages.title: Forbidden Knowledge
passages.text:
Yes, yes. Excellent work, these are some of my favorites.

Knowledge is power, and now I can leave for the spires feeling well-armed.

passages.title: Kura's Vengeance
passages.text:
I was a wing-guard myself, once upon a time.

One afternoon, I was caught away from my post. I just wanted an hour to watch the festival... Kuuan was supposed to cover for me, but instead he sold me out to gain favor with our superiors.

They plucked my eyes, broke my wings, and threw me off the spire.

Yet I am the fortunate one, for if Iskar hadn't found me, I'd have died there. And now Kuuan shows his face in Veil Shadar on the same day that you show up willing to kill for coin. Fortunate, indeed.

passages.title: Kura's Vengeance
passages.text:
Speaking of fortune, count yourself lucky that I was not among the defenders in Aruuna, for you'd have seen both ends of your guts before you laid eyes on the Fire-Sage.

Ah, sometimes I miss those days.

Here is your coin.

passages.title: Chasing Shadows
passages.text:
Not all of the Shadowmoon orcs followed Ner'zhul's alliance with the Iron Horde.

Among them, there is one orc whom I befriended many years ago. She may be able to tell us more about Ner'zhul's plans for this "Dark Star."

She can be found at Exile's Rise to the northeast. I will send word ahead so she expects your arrival.

passages.title: Chasing Shadows
passages.text:
I felt that this day would come. The draenei prophet is not wrong to seek me, traveler.

Though we do not speak often, he and I have a deep mutual respect for one another.

I know the trouble that his people are suffering, and I no longer believe the Shadowmoon are following our ancestor's path.

For those reasons, I will help you.

passages.title: A Flare for the Dramatic
passages.text:
I received a strange object with a note attached. Here, it seems to be written in your tongue, commander.

<Dear Mister Durotan,

I'm Penny... you know, from Azeroth? We met briefly back at adventurer's garrison. 

Anyway, like I told you, I have a fifth degree black hammer in engineering and I'm eager to serve. The more danger the better!

You just fire this old flare whenever you're in trouble and I'll be there, quick as a quark!

Hopefully,

Penny>

passages.title: A Flare for the Dramatic
passages.text: Hey there, commander!

passages.title: A Flare for the Dramatic
passages.text:
That didn't seem to do much, commander, except to give away our position to every creature in Gorgrond.

Wait, did you hear something?

passages.title: Northshire Dash Practice
passages.text:
Welcome to the Irongnome games! For this challenge: run through the arch, then get to the blue marker and return here as fast as you can.

You have all the time you need.

passages.title: To the Slaughter
passages.text:
This entrance to the fortress is clear again, thanks to your help.

Inside is another story. Find your way inside and leave no ogre standing as you go.

passages.title: To the Slaughter
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: To the Slaughter
passages.text: Again we meet...

passages.title: Rooter the Ravenous
passages.text:
The stray boar is digging through garbage left behind by the iron horde. He stops chewing and stares at you-then he burps.

He smells terrible.

It looks like he's chewing on a chunk of rotten meat. Maybe you can find something a bit healthier for him to snack on?

passages.title: Rooter the Ravenous
passages.text: That rotten meat looks gross. Find rooter something healthy to eat.

passages.title: Rooter the Ravenous
passages.text:
You feed the hungry boar the nopales. He devours them whole and smacks his lips.

Rooter jumps up onto you and licks your face with his disgusting tongue.

It looks like you have made a new friend.

passages.title: Insatiable Swarms
passages.text:
Something has spurred the podlings that live in the nearby forest to come here. They are scaring the talbuk, eating the crops, and slaughtering my people!

I led refugees from Tuurem here in search of safety from the Iron Horde, and now we have to contend with these foul creatures!

Please, you must help us! I need to attend to my wife's wounds and guide her to safety. Meet me inside the farm proper towards the back when their numbers have been culled back.

passages.title: Talbuk Roundup
passages.text:
My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!

The little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!

Will you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!

passages.title: Moving In
passages.text: Gorr'thog is now dead. It is time now to secure our hold on Bladespire Citadel. Meet me below and we can begin strengthening our presence.

passages.title: Moving In
passages.text: You have accomplished great things. We could not have captured this citadel without you.

passages.title: The Iron Missive
passages.text:
<The missive outlines a plan to pollute Elekk Acres to ruin the Draenei food supply while their leader, Thokk, sends a force from a camp on the hill to the northwest to slaughter the remaining refugees.>

<If you burn their supplies here and their forward camp with the torches they left here, you can buy precious time to organize a defense against the imminent attack!>

passages.title: The Sacking of the Saberon
passages.text:
The stash mostly contains bits of old animal parts and other junk. Upon closer inspection there are remains of a bundle of herbs and plants.

Rakthoth might be more willing to help if some of these herb bundles were found and gathered for her...

passages.title: The Sacking of the Saberon
passages.text: I need more reagents before I return to my brothers and sisters.

passages.title: The Sacking of the Saberon
passages.text:
So they started storing their herbs in personal stashes instead of their storage dens, good to know.

You have helped me a great deal <name>.

passages.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
passages.text:
After the saberon stole from these plants, they were forced further up Steamscar Rise and barricaded themselves in. I could not find a way to get in but you have the solution.

One path is blocked by a boulder, but it looks weak. A strong warrior, such as an ogre, could break it.

I think you know an ogre gladiator...

passages.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
passages.text: Good work, but we need to move quickly before the plants realize the way is open...

passages.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
passages.text:
After the saberon stole from these plants, they were forced further up Steamscar Rise and barricaded themselves in. I could not find a way to get in but you have the solution.

One path is blocked by a tangle of hard vines. I have heard you have a machine that could cut through that with ease.

I would get on a shredder and take those vines down.

passages.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
passages.text: Good work, but we need to move quickly before the plants realize the way is open...

passages.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
passages.text:
I have seen a tough looking "tree" in that growth. It cries and moans but does not act hostile.

It may know how to get rid of these plants. Go and see if it does.

passages.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
passages.text:
So that is why the saberon have barricaded themselves up there. They are good hunting <name>, and I want to get in there!

I have an idea about that...

passages.title: That's No Podling
passages.text:
<This leaf appears to have come from a plant hydra. The refugee sightings Beldos mentioned must have been true!>

<If one got to the farm, the draenei refugees would stand no chance. Killing it now would buy valuable time for the refugees to reach safety.>

<It must still be at the nearby podling den to the west.>

passages.title: Reagents from Rakthoth
passages.text:
The destruction of our village will not be easy to come back from. Our best hunter, Rakthoth, "finds" reagents for our shaman.

She has not been seen for some time and we need those more than ever. Go to her hunting grounds and see if she still lives.

passages.title: Reagents from Rakthoth
passages.text: Marrow sent you? Our village destroyed? I would have been back already if it wasn't for these cursed plant beasts!

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text:
You have helped me and now I will help you, adventurer. The bloom you seek is within the nearby cave, being pawed over by the new leader of these saberon.

Kill him and take the bloom back to the ancient below. I hope this will clear out those plants and I can get back to my hunting...

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text: Do you have something for me, little beast?

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!

passages.title: Sacking the Saberon Stronghold
passages.text: [TEMP]Destroy the barricade and take back stuff!

passages.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
passages.text:
We must not head into battle prematurely. Before we go after Orgrim, we must first deal with his troops.

If we are to succeed in our mission of wiping out the Iron Horde from Talador, we need to start on these shores.

passages.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
passages.text: We will have fewer enemies to deal with at our backs. Lok'tar.

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text:
The manual for the shredder was wedged in there, but it's missing lots of pages. We need to find as many pages of that manual as possible and I might--MIGHT--be able to get this shredder operational.

Based on the direction of the wind, I bet the pages flew toward Archenon Siegeyard.

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text: I don't know why those idiots don't just collect all the pages in one place.

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text: Lots of detail... almost as if a goblin wrote it!

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text:
Excellent, excellent! I'll make sense of these manual pages and will get the Iron Shredder operational immediately!

While I do that, take a look through my Eye 'n' Ear. That's where you'll be headed soon!

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text: Lots of orcs ready to be shredded!

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text: Orgrim seems to be up to no good.

passages.title: Born to Shred
passages.text:
The Iron Shredder is operational! It should be primed and ready for you to shred our enemies in Tuurem!

Head inside and see what damage you can do. Can't say I'm not jealous.

passages.title: Born to Shred
passages.text: What's up, boss?

passages.title: Born to Shred
passages.text: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --

passages.title: Engineering Her Demise
passages.text: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --

passages.title: Engineering Her Demise
passages.text: Gazlowe has been invaluable in securing Talador. Now, it is up to us.

passages.title: The Battle for Shattrath
passages.text:
To stop the Iron Horde, we must overcome prejudice and work together, if only for this purpose.

Horde, Alliance, past, present... all meaningless in the face of this enemy.

We will retake Shattrath together... or die trying.

passages.title: The Battle for Shattrath
passages.text: I cannot believe Orgrim is truly dead. Blackhand has carved a hole in my heart, and I intend to destroy him when the opportunity presents itself.

passages.title: Karmaan
passages.text:
You saw iron horde fighting the podlings!? That must be why the podlings are attacking here; they've been displaced!

Unfortunately, they likely followed me and the other refugees from Tuurem to here. Light help me, I've doomed us all.

We should go tell Karmaan about this. If the iron horde is nearby, podlings might be the least of our problems.

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text:
The enemy has explosive devices stored on the beach below. We must recover them so they are not used against us.

Reports indicate that crates of explosives are scattered along the shoreline.

While you search, Durotan and I will carve deeper into Iron Horde territory.

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text: Have you found the Iron Horde Explosives yet?

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text: I believe we can use these at Archenon Siegeyard.

passages.title: Iron Them Out
passages.text:
The orcs themselves are not the only threat. We may have weakened them considerably, but they still have siege weapons of significant power.

Sabotage siege weapons you find with the explosives you collected from the beach.

passages.title: Iron Them Out
passages.text: It is a relief to know that their weapons of war cannot be used against us.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED]Y'kish Joins the Party
passages.text: The little guy sure does look happy. It's pretty clear he wants you to pet him. There is a spot right on the top of his head that isn't totally covered in rotten meat.

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text:
Your allies sent along a goblin, Gazlowe, to advise us against the Iron Horde. Thus far, he has proven a valuable asset.

He has a looking glass set up that can see a great distance and, he claims, even hear.

Use this looking glass and report back what you've seen. I will stick to my standard spyglass.

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text: Take a look through Gazlowe's Eye 'n' Ear.

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text: Orgrim leads these orcs? Why has he pledged himself to the Iron Horde?

passages.title: Dark Enemies
passages.text:
Your arrival should be cause for celebration, hero, but I fear our troubles are just beginning.

Warlord Ner'zhul and his Shadowmoon clan have launched a surprise attack on a draenei settlement to the north.

Prophet Velen has gone to aid the wounded at Teluuna Observatory, but we need more defenders.

I must go to assist the others. If you wish to help us, go to Arbor Glen and kill any Shadowmoon enemies that you see.

passages.title: Dark Enemies
passages.text: The forests are clear of Shadowmoon enemies? Good. I knew that you would not fail.

passages.title: The Thing in the Cave
passages.text:
The note reads as follows:

"It cannot be defeated. No matter how many troops we send at it, it seemingly cannot be destroyed.

"We have lost too many lives as it is. I refuse to send another orc after that thing. Instead, we will establish a guard station outside the cave's mouth to keep it from getting out."

passages.title: The Thing in the Cave
passages.text:
The note reads as follows:

"It cannot be defeated. No matter how many troops we send at it, it seemingly cannot be destroyed.

"We have lost too many lives as it is. I refuse to send another orc after that thing. Instead, we will establish a guard station outside the cave's mouth to keep it from getting out."

passages.title: The Survivalist's Way
passages.text:
I was tracking the Iron Horde's movements through the Iron March when I was spotted by one of their chimera riders.

I was able to fight off their kill squad, but I'm too injured to keep going. Stranger, I must obtain as much recon as possible to aid in Karabor's defense.

If you can bring me silk from the worms and a handful of teeth from the rays at the lake nearby, I can operate on my wounds and fashion a bandage that ought to hold long enough for me to finish my mission.

passages.title: Keeping the Balance
passages.text:
Look at these teeth, friend. These stress markings suggest that the crocolisk are being subjugated by one of their own. When a crocolisk female grows large enough, she exerts dominance over her kin.

It is my duty as a hunter to ensure balance is restored to these creatures as thanks for their sacrifice for my own life.

Track down the beast and slay her while I tend to my wounds. She is likely at the far end of the arbitum.

passages.title: Kuuros Farm
passages.text:
Many refugees from Tuurem have made their way to Kuuros Farm east of here.

If you are able, please venture there and find Beldos. He led the refugees there from Tuurem and will be the best point of contact.

passages.title: Gormaul Tower
passages.text:
It is time for us to strike out against those who would enslave us!

We travel to Gormaul Tower to wrest it from the Bladespire ogres. I would welcome your company.

Mount up, and together we will ride to battle!

passages.title: Gormaul Tower
passages.text: You may ride with us and fight with our pack.

passages.title: Gormaul Tower
passages.text: I now understand how you were able to rescue my clan from the clutches of slavery. Such power!

passages.title: Karg Unchained
passages.text:
They took my brothers and sisters.

They took my wolf.

<Karg lifts his axe and fixes his gaze upon its edge.>

Now we take their heads.

passages.title: Karg Unchained
passages.text:
By killing them - we take their heads by killing them.

We don't actually need to pick up the heads.

passages.title: Karg Unchained
passages.text:
<Karg scoops up a handful of snow and cleans the gore from his axe.>

You fight well.

passages.title: Crippled Caravan
passages.text:
I'm getting reports that the botani have started leaving their bloom and attacking wandering travelers. This is most unusual.

We already dispatched a number of rangari to try and resolve this issue.

A caravan from Azeroth passed through here recently, you should probably check on your people to ensure their safety.

passages.title: Crippled Caravan
passages.text:
Commander! Am I glad to see you.

We have a situation here.

passages.title: Fiona's Solution
passages.text:
Gidwin was attacked by one of those plant creatures.

From the looks of it, he is suffering from some kind of paralysis.

I can make a cure, but I'll need some local ingredients.

passages.title: Fiona's Solution
passages.text: Do you have the ingredients?

passages.title: Fiona's Solution
passages.text: Bang-up job, <name>! The base is just about ready.

passages.title: Cooking With Unstable Herbs
passages.text:
The base is boiling and ready for those ingredients.

Add each of the ingredients, one at a time, and I will handle the mixing and frothing. Speak to me when you are ready.

passages.title: Cooking With Unstable Herbs
passages.text: Are you ready to begin?

passages.title: Cooking With Unstable Herbs
passages.text:
Gidwin is looking much better. Thank you, <name>.

We have just enough elixir here to help the others.

passages.title: [Deprecated] Lifebloom Orchids
passages.text:
<Based on the footprints leading into the marsh, Susanna Eyesley was clearly being chased by something.>

<Renault's men were using these same herbs to heal the wounded. If you brought some to her she could probably make a healing draught out of them.>

passages.title: The Great Salvation
passages.text:
We've located the prisoners. They are being held in captivity here, inside the Shadowmoon fortress.

Please rescue as many of them as you can. And hurry. We can hear their screams out here.

passages.title: The Great Salvation
passages.text: We are taking care of the survivors now. We owe their lives to you. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Across the Stars
passages.text:
A key source of the Shadowmoon clan's power comes from their understanding of the stars and their omens.

For centuries, they have recorded the patterns of the stars and their interpretations.

While you are in the fortress, collect some of these documents for me.

We will take their own knowledge and use it against them.

passages.title: Across the Stars
passages.text: Your aid is appreciated, <class>.

passages.title: Across the Stars
passages.text: Thank you. My acolytes will study these in great detail. With any luck, we will be able to use this knowledge to defeat the Shadowmoon.

passages.title: Free Our Brothers and Sisters
passages.text:
These Thunderlord curs use coward's weapons like nets and chains.

Many of our villagers and wolf-brothers and sisters have been trapped.

If you free them, they will fight at your side with honor.

We must quell this attack with haste so I may return to Bladespire Citadel and continue my preparations.

passages.title: Free Our Brothers and Sisters
passages.text:
The Frostwolf clan cannot be held like beasts.

You fight with honor, <name>.

passages.title: In Need of a Hero
passages.text:
I...<sob>... I can't leave...<gulp>... without... Squiggy...!

He... he's... trapped!

You need... to put out... the fire!

<Ariaana points across the room and bursts into tears.>

passages.title: In Need of a Hero
passages.text: Squiggy... is... my... best... friend!

passages.title: In Need of a Hero
passages.text: You did it! Squiggy is okay!

passages.title: Fast Expansion
passages.text:
Greetings, Commander.

I am here on behalf of architect Baros Alexston.

We have gathered enough resources for the next phase of expansion.

He wishes to speak to you at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Fast Expansion
passages.text: Ah, welcome, commander! Just the person I wished to see.

passages.title: A Song of Frost and Fire
passages.text:
You have rescued many of my clan from the slave pens of Tanaan. Their liberation and the destruction of the Dark Portal are more than enough for me to consider you one of us.

However, you are still a stranger to our leader, Durotan. I would like to introduce you to him.

passages.title: A Song of Frost and Fire
passages.text: What a strange creature you are.

passages.title: A Song of Frost and Fire
passages.text: I thank you for returning with my people, and I welcome you as an honored guest.

passages.title: Honor Has Its Rewards
passages.text:
You have honored my people. Now, we wish to honor you.

We have a rite of initiation in my clan. When one comes of age, they cover themselves in the blood of their first hunt, and rest their hands upon a shamanstone to honor the ancestors who came before them.

In our brief time together you have already slain many foes more fierce than our hunters have ever had to face. Go, touch the shamanstone here in Wor'gol, and join our pack as an equal.

passages.title: Honor Has Its Rewards
passages.text: Thank you for saving my clan.

passages.title: Honor Has Its Rewards
passages.text: If you choose to continue to help our clan, the other Shamanstones will sense your closeness to the Frostwolves and might bless you with more gifts.

passages.title: Signs of a Struggle
passages.text:
Judging by the markings, it appears to be a journal kept by a Shadowmoon orc.

<Hagra disappeared last night. She is the fifth in as many nights. Why do they only vanish at night?>

<I will find out. Tonight I wait for whatever manner of beast stalks our village.>

<I will bring the beast's head to Rulkan, and return my kin to their homes.>

Perhaps the beast's head is in one of the bags in the debris up ahead?

passages.title: Laabru's Rebellion
passages.text:
Laabru wouldn't listen. He killed one of the guards and they dragged him off to one of their tents.

They are going to kill him for sure!

passages.title: Where's My Wolf?!
passages.text:
My frost wolf, Nerok, was captured with me and the others. I do not know where they are keeping him, but I'll bet the so-called "beastmaster" who dragged us here does.

He is at the beast pens nearby, boasting about his catch to the younger hunters.

We'll see how he boasts with my axe in his skull.

passages.title: Where's My Wolf?!
passages.text: I will not leave my frost wolf behind. Dead or alive, Nerok leaves this place with me.

passages.title: Where's My Wolf?!
passages.text: Nerok and I are the only surviving prisoners, but we cannot leave just yet.

passages.title: The Master Siegesmith
passages.text:
Not long ago, the most advanced weapon a Thunderlord could make was a really, really big spear. The Blackrock orcs must have shipped in a fearsome master to have them producing cannons so rapidly.

We need to find that master.

passages.title: The Master Siegesmith
passages.text: Karg is right - this is our best opportunity to cripple Grom'gar's defenses. We do this, then we return to the clan, heads high with pride.

passages.title: The Master Siegesmith
passages.text: The Iron Horde combines the strengths of every clan. We must continue looking for ways to sever those connections if we hope to defeat them.

passages.title: zzOLD Honor Has its Rewards
WANTED: Maa'run's Hoof
passages.text:
Posted by: Orrin

A wild talbuk called "Maa'run" wanders the hills southeast of Embaari Village and west of The Draakorium.

My brother was injured by this foul beast, and now lays in recovery.

For the safety of all the nearby villages, we must put an end to this vicious, rampaging creature!

A handsome reward will be given to anyone who can bring me his hoof as proof of his demise.

passages.title: WANTED: Maa'run's Hoof
passages.text:
My brother, Anduur, gathers wild berries from the hills above our village.

It was during one of his excursions that he met up with Maa'run.

I demand retribution for his injuries.

passages.title: WANTED: Maa'run's Hoof
passages.text: Thank you, adventurer! We can rest more easily knowing that this beast has been put to its end.

passages.title: Darkness Falls
passages.text:
It is already beginning, over the hills to the southeast.

Ner'zhul has everything he needs to summon the Dark Star. The Iron Horde attack on Karabor is imminent. This is where everything ends.

Champion, I must ask you to ride ahead and delay Ner'zhul. I will join you as quickly as I can.

passages.title: Darkness Falls
passages.text: Today is the day that everything ends. But something new rises from the ashes.

passages.title: Darkness Falls
passages.text:
Prophet Velen is gone, and yet there is no time to mourn.

We will honor Velen's passing once the Iron Horde have fled from these hills.

Now, champion, is the time to fight!

passages.title: Smeltcraft
passages.text:
Stranger! Thank the spirits for them sending you to me now. I am forging a blade and cannot leave it at this delicate state.

But I need more ore to complete this task.

Here, take my mining pick. It is crafted from the teeth and acid of the local goren and will cut through the ore of this area as if it were air.

Bring me the ore and I will lend this blade to your cause.

passages.title: Smeltcraft
passages.text: The power of a weapon comes both from the test of its metal and the skill of the hands that wield it.

passages.title: Smeltcraft
passages.text: Perfect timing. The steel of the blade is still malleable. A few more strikes and my work shall be complete.

passages.title: Vignette: Broodmother Reeg'ak
passages.text:
Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.

Fortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.

If we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

passages.title: The Pale Hunter
passages.text:
Spiders!

Where is my father!

I feel so... so... good? Bad? Don't judge me! Leave me alone! I'm sleeping... in my brain.

AHH!! More bunnies!

<The dwarves eyes are extremely dilated. She appears to be hallucinating. >

passages.title: The Home of the Frostwolves
passages.text: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.

passages.title: The Home of the Frostwolves
passages.text:
<The shaman grins at the harsh, windblown shore.>

Welcome to the home of my people, <name>.

passages.title: Seek Out the Seer
passages.text:
We've been watching you, <name>.

Seer Malune, keeper of memories, has requested an audience with you, adventurer.

She has long foretold the coming of a great hero to destroy the lurking shadow. We believe you are that hero.

Come to Duskfall Island, not far south of here, and fulfill your destiny.

passages.title: Seek Out the Seer
passages.text: I am Seer Malune, the great keeper of memories. It is an honor to finally meet you.

passages.title: Dust of the Dead
passages.text:
I thought if I could just bring him here that I might be able to correct his transgression against the Light. That perhaps I could save my son! Now my beloved Arumel is a twisted phantasm.

I'm left with no choice but to right my wrongs and I need your help.

Bring me duskwing dust from the moths on Duskfall Island. With your aid I can craft an elixir that will let us travel to the realm of the dead and lay Arumel to rest.

passages.title: Dust of the Dead
passages.text: Do you have enough dust?

passages.title: Dust of the Dead
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. With this dust and Aruunem berries I will craft the draught of the dead.

passages.title: Cure of Aruunem
passages.text:
I need your help in creating an elixir that will allow us passage into the realm of the dead.

In order to create it I require a sampling of the local vegetation. You will find Aruunem berries scattered about on the island. Bring me as many as you can carry.

Be warned, <name>: do not eat them raw! The poison in the berries would kill you within minutes!

passages.title: Cure of Aruunem
passages.text: Have you collected enough Aruunem berries?

passages.title: Cure of Aruunem
passages.text: I'm glad you did not eat any berries. I'm not sure what I would do if you were to die.

passages.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
passages.text:
It's uncommon to see goren in Talador. We need to get a handle on this situation before it spreads and we lose all of our precious gems.

The only answer is to dispose of the creatures, and quickly!

It is imperative that you kill the leader too! If you don't they will just continue to come back.

passages.title: Destroy Diggers [PH]
passages.text:
This goren attack was horrible, but maybe we can learn from them. Maybe we can use this tragedy to our benefit.

The goren's primary weapon is a metal melting spit. You'll need to be careful in there, lest you loose that shiny armor!

It would be too dangerous to collect it when it's fresh, but maybe once it's solidified...

See if you can bring me a few samples.

If my hypothesis is correct we may be able to weaponize it against the Iron Horde.

passages.title: No Miner Left Behind
passages.text:
In all of my years working the quarry I have never seen goren in this number. They came on so quickly, we had no time to react.

Now the quarry has been weakened from their tunneling and eating. it's only a matter of time before the whole thing collapses.

I refuse to leave anyone to die in there with those things! Please help me, <race>. Save as many of my miners as you can.

passages.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
passages.text:
I was all set to take a little trip to the nearby quarry when all of the sudden a bunch of goren bust out of the ground and started wreaking havoc!

It would be a shame for all of those beautiful gems to be destroyed by those filthy creatures. All they do is eat them! Can you believe that?!

Be a dear and dispose of them. Make sure you get rid of the leader or they will only come back.

passages.title: Collect Crystals [PH]
passages.text:
