We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact our latest recruit, Knewbie McGreen just came through the portal today.

If you are looking to trade for weapons or armor, Vindicator Nuurem will be happy to help.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: How did your walk go?

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.

passages.title: A Surly Dwarf
passages.text:
Before you go there is someone you might want to talk with.

He's opinionated, a bit gruff, and very overbearing, but he's the best damn warrior I've met in ages.

He belongs on the front lines with you, commander. And trust me, he knows it.

passages.title: A Surly Dwarf
passages.text: Look, I don't have time for any... Oh, it's you!

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: Ever since we built da menagerie, a lot o' "visitors" been showin' up. I know da look, and they be lookin' for a fight. <Brudda/Sista>, you show 'em you da real master 'round here.

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: Did you show 'em the mojo?

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: You showed 'em, boss!

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
passages.text:
Welcome to Nagrand's one and only Ring of Blood, where hopefuls become gladiators and gladiators become discarded piles of meat on the arena floor!

Talk to me to start a fight, hop down into the ring, and fight for your life. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!

You'll face off against an ogron that has a hankering for freshly severed heads. You'll be fine... and I'll be rich!

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
passages.text: Nicely done, pal. Now how's about we kick things up a notch?

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Fracktus!
passages.text:
Have you ever fought a living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face? Well, today's your lucky day!

Fracktus is a... well... living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face, actually. Got that one right the first time!

Just hop in the ring so we can get started, will ya?

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Fracktus!
passages.text: Incredible! You've got real moxy, kid.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Venoxis!
passages.text:
Alright, alright, how about this. A living, breathing... wait for it.... tree... that wants to murder your face. Genius, right?

Look, they don't pay me to come up with witty dialogue about these things, give me a break. They're ogres - they pay for blood. Hence the name.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Venoxis!
passages.text: You're the best I've ever seen in all my years as a promoter. I really mean that.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Dreshax!
passages.text:
You're going to love this one, champ.

That's right, it's the largest bone worm this side of Draenor. Dreshax lovingly disposes of all of the suckers... I mean... fallen gladiators for us.

Think you've got what it takes? Hop on in and wait. Dreshax's lair is just below the arena - he'll come to you.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Dreshax!
passages.text: What a battle. What a fight! Incredible!

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
Word of your glory in battle has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.

Well done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
passages.text:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
passages.text:
Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.

Well done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text: I hear you were a sight to see in the ring. I'm proud to serve by your side, commander.

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text:
We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.

Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text: Da assault be goin' well I hope?

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text:
News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.

Ya be a force to be reckonin' with.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Alliance try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Alliance.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
News about da fightin' beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils too.

Dem Alliance must a been none too happy to see ya on the field.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
I been hearin' ya were a sight ya see in the ring.

We made some bets on ya. Easy money.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Mogor!
passages.text:
You've really done it this time, champ. Mogor has challenged you to uphold his title as lord of the ring!

I wish I could give you tips to help you make it out of there in one piece, but I've never seen Mogor fight. Nobody's ever gotten this far!

Good luck.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Mogor!
passages.text: You did it. You really did it! You're the new lord of the ring!

passages.title: Ashran Appearance
passages.text:
Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander.

It would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area.

I can arrange a flight if you are interested.

passages.title: Ashran Appearance
passages.text: Commander! I am humbled to be able to serve you. The Lieutenant requests your presence.

passages.title: Warspear Welcome
passages.text:
Lieutenant Kragil said you might be showing up.

I've been ordered to take you to the inn.

passages.title: Warspear Welcome
passages.text: Throm-Ka, commander. I am pleased to finally meet you in person.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text:
I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards.

This inn is run by Narnin Dawnglow, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor.

We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact one of out latest recruits, Zarjhin, just came through the portal today.

If you are looking for weapons or armor Beska Redtusk will be happy to help.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: How did your walk go?

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.

passages.title: Burning Beauty
passages.text:
Before you go, there is someone you should meet.

She might set some of your stuff on fire, but I believe she's the best mage this side of Draenor.

She belongs on the front lines with you, commander.

passages.title: Burning Beauty
passages.text: So, you are the commander? Sylvanas sent me to find you.

passages.title: Abu'gar
passages.text:
Ya brought my gear! Well it be lookin' like my luck might be turnin' around after all!

Abu'gar will be returnin' the favor, just ya wait and see!

Right after I hook myself a lunker, of course...

passages.title: The Initiate's Revenge
passages.text:
I... I'm finished. My spirit will be with the Raven Mother soon.

I beg of you, stranger... avenge me! Slay these filthy beasts.

passages.title: The Initiate's Revenge
passages.text:
The lives of all the flock are precious.
I'm glad to know that his murderers have been brought to justice.

Thank you, <name>, you have done us a great honor.

passages.title: The Flock's Revenge
passages.text:
The Bloodmane took several of our initiates when they ambushed our ritual in Ravenskar. They must be taught that the flock will never allow such a deed to go unpunished!

We will kill one of their tribe for each of the flock that has fallen!

head into their accursed home of Bloodmane Valley and slaughter as many of them as you can find.

passages.title: One Step Ahead
passages.text:
Commander, Vindicator Maraad set off with Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil to track the Iron Horde's movements in the nearby forest.

They await your arrival on a small rise to the southwest.

passages.title: One Step Ahead
passages.text: Ah, Commander <name>. Good to see you. Now our party is complete.

passages.title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
Assault on the Broken Precipice
Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.title: They Came From Above
passages.text:
Please, traveler, I need your help.

Aruuna, my home, has been destroyed by the arakkoa. They swooped down from their spires and killed anyone who tried to escape. My family... did not make it out.

 My brother Barum stayed behind to find his daughter amidst the chaos. I beseech you, please, go to Aruuna and find Barum.

He is the only family I have left.

passages.title: They Came From Above
passages.text: Akhan is alive? Light bless us - some good news!

passages.title: Ogre Waygates
passages.text:
Six unique gates exist in Draenor, built by ogre magi in ages past. We've discovered their potency has not diminished over the millennia.

If you can collect enough ogre waystones to activate one of these ancient waygates, we can build a portal from your garrison to that location.

passages.title: Ogre Waygates
passages.text: Did you activate a waygate?

passages.title: Ogre Waygates
passages.text: Your efforts will be well rewarded, <name>.  The ancient waygates now serve you.

passages.title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
passages.text:
Commander, a goblin courier arrived this morning.

He mentioned that he is from a settlement in the Spires of Arak called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They have requested our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster.

If we can earn their trust it'll be worth the effort. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide.

I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

passages.title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
passages.text:
Hey, you're from that Alliance base right?

Glad you made the trip because we really could use your help!

passages.title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
passages.text:
Commander, a courier arrived this morning.

He said he's from a goblin settlement in Spires of Arak called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They've asked for our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster.

We're spread thin but if we can earn their trust then we might be able to gain a valuable ally.

Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide. I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

passages.title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
passages.text:
Hey, you're from that Horde base right?

Glad you made the trip because we really could use your help!

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text:
Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor. Head out to local waters here in Shadowmoon Valley and see what you can do. All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text: Find anything worth keeping?

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text: This will do nicely... A fish like this would be hard for anyone to deny, especially Nat!

passages.title: Warlords of Draenor: The Dark Portal
passages.text:
<name>, is it? I'm glad you're here. We can use every able-bodied <class> that we can get.

I am assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to step through this Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde invasion. This may be the only way to save Azeroth.

Will you join us?

passages.title: Warlords of Draenor: The Dark Portal
passages.text: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text:
What's this species, an arcane trout you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up. Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text: You found Nat? The real Nat Pagle?!

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text: We should really catch some big one's when Nat's gets here!

passages.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
passages.text:
Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion.

Around me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall, <name>. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you.

Now select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.

passages.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
passages.text:
A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission.

If your choice is certain, your aim will be true.

Strike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! For the Horde. For Draenor.

passages.title: Besting a Boar
passages.text:
Have you seen the boars they have here? Bigger than I am! Let's get one of them, why not?

You're going to have to head to Gorgrond for that task. Way out in the desolate regions, you'll find the ones we're lookin' for.

passages.title: Besting a Boar
passages.text: That boar has taken to the hay. We'll let it rest up a bit before more training.

passages.title: Wrangling a Wolf
passages.text:
This next one will test you to your very limits, commander. The wolf is the most savage beast in all of Draenor.

The wolves of Nagrand, mounts of the fabled Warsong clan, can rend a man to bits in seconds. They're also faster and more agile than anything you've seen yet.

Here's your lasso. Good luck, and don't get yourself killed!

passages.title: Wrangling a Wolf
passages.text: It almost bit me, but I've got it bedded down and happy. A wolf, in my stables! Who'd have thought?

passages.title: Besting a Boar
passages.text:
The great boars of Gorgrond appear to serve as both a mount and an excellent source of food. Having a few of them in the garrison would not be an unwise idea.

I have created for you another rope, should you wish to ride one down. Be wary of the Iron Horde presence nearby.

passages.title: Besting a Boar
passages.text: The boar has taken to the stables quite quickly. They appear to be nearly domesticated already. It will need some time to rest.

passages.title: Wrangling a Wolf
passages.text:
The wolves of this land have jaws of steel. It is no wonder that the orcs have taken them as their own.

Yet, deep in Nagrand, there are young wolves, ripe for taming. They will present a great challenge to you, as they are more fast and agile than any beast in this land.

Here is your final rope, may luck be with you.

passages.title: Wrangling a Wolf
passages.text: Quite the catch, commander. It will need to rest for some time, but will surely be hungry for combat soon.

passages.title: Arakkoa Exodus
passages.text:
I assume you're familiar with the arakkoa, commander? Great, flying birdfolk. Extremely territorial.

Some, however, have withered wings - a disease, maybe. They seem to be outcast from arakkoa society. You find them now and then, squatting in forgotten ruins or peddling trinkets on the roadside.

It seems the Iron Horde has incited the arakkoa by moving into their lands, and the outcasts are fleeing in droves.

We should make contact with these outcasts - they could have valuable information.

passages.title: Arakkoa Exodus
passages.text:
<The arakkoa merchant looks you up and down.>

Well-equipped, aren't we? Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.

Come closer, friend. Speak with me for just a moment.

passages.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
passages.text:
**Eyes Only -- Commander <name>**

Durotan recommended dat we be gettin' a foothold in Nagrand, so I taken the liberty of dispatchin' some of da boys.

Thrall's already reportin' the new outpost be nearly complete. He been askin' me to let ya know they be ready for ya.

A windrider be waitin' to catch ya up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you be ready, <sir/ma'am>.

-- Rokhan

passages.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
passages.text:
They came at us... from... nowhere.

<The stoneguard nearly passes out.>

passages.title: It's a Matter of Strategy
passages.text:
**Eyes Only -- Commander <name>**

The Iron Horde have proved themselves worthy foes.

They managed to get their fleet moving to Talador from Gorgrond without my spies seeing a thing. Talador be a crossroads for the whole continent. We can't let them have it.

Don't worry boss, we got a plan. Foreman Grobash be setting up an outpost for our forces as we speak. They be ready for you when you arrive, commander.

--Rokhan

passages.title: It's a Matter of Strategy
passages.text: Your will be done. I require your advisement, commander.

passages.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
passages.text:
Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion.

Around me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall, <name>. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you.

Now select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.

passages.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
passages.text:
A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission.

If your choice is certain, your aim will be true.

Strike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! Glory to the Alliance! For Draenor!

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text:
The first step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it's not trained properly, it might get spooked and run.

Take this little talbuk out to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and take on the biggest beast you can find, together. That should raise its confidence!

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text: Did you manage to bring down Great-Tusk?

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text: That should do it a world of good. We'll let 'er rest for tonight, and take on some bigger targets tomorrow.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
passages.text:
Now that your talbuk has got a taste for combat, let's take it out into an environment it may not be familiar with.

The icy bluffs of Frostfire Ridge should be a good test. Find yourself a big, mean beast out there and take it down with your talbuk.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
passages.text: Oi! That talbuk's performin' admirably. Let's let 'er rest.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
passages.text:
Now plenty of mounts have been known to run away at the sight of a fierce predator. Way out in the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond, they've got some of the fiercest.

Let's put your talbuk to the test. See if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
passages.text: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your talbuk will need a nap after that one.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text:
There's plenty more beasts out in the wild that can make a snack of your favorite mount. One of the most cunning on Draenor is the stalker.

Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your talbuk can't overcome this natural defense mechanism. You'll find some mean stalkers out in Talador.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text: Ye did it! I'm sure your talbuk's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
passages.text:
Way down south in the Spires of Arak, the land's being overtaken by the mushrooms that grow underwater. The result? Strange fungal creatures sprouting up all over the place.

Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, gives us a great chance to expose your talbuk to predators it's unfamiliar with.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
passages.text: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text:
Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.

There is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your talbuk reacts to that.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text:
The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of 'em.

Head on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text:
Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.

If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your talbuk. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
passages.text:
The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.

In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your talbuk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
passages.text: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
passages.text:
Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!

The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your talbuk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
passages.text: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text:
The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.

Out in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your talbuk and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.

passages.title: Boar Training: Riplash
passages.text:
That boar's seen it's share of combat out in Gorgrond, so it'll be a bit easier to train. We'll start off in it's home, as you've done with yer other beasties.

See if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.

passages.title: Boar Training: The Garn
passages.text:
I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.

They call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.

There's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your boar, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your boar will truly be ready.

passages.title: Boar Training: The Garn
passages.text:
Your rocktusk is now ready to see combat, commander. Here's the reins, you'll need 'em ridin' this bucket of muscle!

Great job with the training!

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text:
This beast's spent quite a few years out in the wilds of Talador, I'd say we start the training there. It's fairly docile, as well. I don't think it will take quite as long to train as the others.

As ye probably know, stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your riverbeast can't overcome this natural defense mechanism.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text: Ye did it! I'm sure your riverbeast's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.

Head on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text:
Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.

If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your riverbeast. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Thundercall
passages.text:
The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.

In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your riverbeast and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Thundercall
passages.text: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Ironbore
passages.text:
Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!

The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your riverbeast on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Ironbore
passages.text: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text:
The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.

Out in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your riverbeast and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!

passages.title: Riverbeast Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text:

Let's set it loose against the ogres of the region that yer familiar with. That Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, go on and see how your wolf reacts to that.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.

passages.title: Boar Training: Riplash
passages.text:
This boar is at home in the rocky plains of Gorgrond, so it will be easier to train. As with other beasts, we will begin the training in the place it calls home.

Test your boar against the great predator Riplash, a raptor known to hunt boars.

passages.title: Boar Training: Riplash
passages.text: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.

passages.title: Boar Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text:
Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning on is the stalker.

Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.

passages.title: Boar Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.

passages.text:

passages.title: Boar Training: Bulbapore
passages.text: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.

passages.title: Boar Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.

passages.title: Boar Training: The Garn
passages.text:
The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land.

The garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them.

There is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your boar, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your boar will truly be ready.

passages.title: Boar Training: The Garn
passages.text: The garn is defeated, and your boar is now ready to see combat. Here are the reins, may you never part company.

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text:
At the armory, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.

Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text: Got those scraps?

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text: Those scraps will do.

passages.title: Unconventional Inventions
passages.text:
We've got a lot goin' on here at the workshop. We're buildin' new inventions all the time, and you can find 'em behind me on the workbench.

Go ahead and grab today's glorious invention. Use it at your own risk.

passages.title: Unconventional Inventions
passages.text: A goblin workshop can get dangerous. Watch out for exploding explosives!

passages.title: Unconventional Inventions
passages.text: Pretty cool invention you have there.

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text:
Hey der mon, I be ya new headhunter. 
The tavern be a perfect place for adventurers to rest after a long journey. It also be a great place to talk them into joining our cause.

I be havin' a few recruits for ya to look at, if ya find one we can hire then I'll give ya a little somethin' as a finder fee for ya time.

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text: Ya find a recruit ya like?

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text:
I'm glad ya be findin' a good hire!

Make sure to check back every week and I'll bring ya me latest recruits.

passages.title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text:
The next step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it is not trained properly, it might become afraid at a very inopportune time.

Though small, take your clefthoof to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and find the greatest beast you can. It will grow quickly against such a foe.

passages.title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text: Your clefthoof appears worn, but happy. You have done well, let it rest for a while.

passages.title: Clefthoof Training: Rakkiri
passages.text:
Your clefthoof is most at home here in Frostfire Ridge, and that is where we will begin the training.

Out on the icy plains, you will find a hunter of blood and death. The winged terror Rakkiri is feared by beasts across this region, and will prove a good first test for your future mount.

passages.title: Clefthoof Training: Rakkiri
passages.text: The clefthoof is in good shape, you are a fine trainer for the beast. It will require some rest.

passages.title: Clefthoof Training: Riplash
passages.text:
Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge.

Take your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text:
<Sir/Ma'am>, the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.

Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.

If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text: Hello commander, what can I do for you?

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text:
Thank you, according to the ledger that appears to be everything we're missing.
Those peons are going to be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!

passages.title: Tricks of the Trade
passages.text:
To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.

Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.

Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.

passages.title: Tricks of the Trade
passages.text: Trading isn't always the most exciting enterprise. But I do enjoy it.

passages.title: Tricks of the Trade
passages.text: You have learned one of my tricks of the trade, <name>.

passages.title: Call of the Gladiator
passages.text:
Your merciless rampage has not gone unnoticed, gladiator. So many of your enemies have fallen before your might. It is because of your unrelenting savagery that Imperator Mar'gok himself has requested your presence at the grand Highmaul Coliseum. It is at Highmaul that a battle of epic proportions awaits.

Should you heed the call of the gladiator, present this sigil to my brother, Kharg. He is the arena master residing outside of the Coliseum in Nagrand.

passages.title: Call of the Gladiator
passages.text: A bold decision, gladiator. For most, death is the only thing they find at the Coliseum. Surviving here is more than a test of skill, it is a test of wills. Do you have the fortitude to become a champion?

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text:
<Sir/Ma'am>, the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.

Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.

If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text: Hello commander, what can I do for you?

passages.title: Lost in Transition
passages.text: According to the ledger this appears to be everything we're missing. Those porters will be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!

passages.title: Tricks of the Trade
passages.text:
To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.

Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.

Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.

passages.title: Tricks of the Trade
passages.text: You have learned one of my tricks of the trade, <name>.

passages.title: Unconventional Inventions
passages.text:
The workshop is bustling with the whir of minds and motors. We're coming up with new inventions all the time.

Try out today's glorious invention on the workbench behind me.

passages.title: Unconventional Inventions
passages.text: Nice invention!

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text:
At the Dwarven Bunker, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.

Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text: Got those scraps?

passages.title: Scraps of Iron
passages.text: Those scraps will do.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text:
The talbuk is ready for more training, and for this, we will return to its home in Shadowmoon Valley.

One of the great beasts of this land, Great-Tusk, has taken the valley for his own. Pit your beast against him in combat, and if you should survive, it will have greater confidence in its own abilities.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
passages.text: That was a fine battle to test your talbuk against. It will need to rest before we can continue the training.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
passages.text:
We shall start training the talbuk here, on the icy plains of Frostfire Ridge. We must train it rigorously, or else it may become afraid at the sight of combat, and run.

Find the great blood-sucker, Rakkiri, out on the frozen plains, and bring him down astride your talbuk. That will give it a taste for combat.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
passages.text: Your talbuk is growing quickly, let us let it rest.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
passages.text:
Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge.

Take your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
passages.text: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text:
Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning is the stalker.

Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
passages.text: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
passages.text:
In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited.

Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
passages.text: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text:
Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.

There is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text:
The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.

Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text:
Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.

If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your talbuk. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
passages.text:
The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.

In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
passages.text: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
passages.text:
You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.

The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
passages.text:
You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.

Allow your mount to rest for the night.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text:
The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.

Out in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

passages.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text:
The wolves of this land are the most savage beasts I have seen, and surely do not fear orc nor ogre.

Bring him to bear against once of the ogres that you are familiar with. The Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, see how the wolf reacts to him.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
passages.text: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text:
The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.

Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Darkwing Roc
passages.text: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text:
Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.

If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Moth of Wrath
passages.text: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Thundercall
passages.text:
The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.

In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Thundercall
passages.text: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
