passages.text:
You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.

The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Ironbore
passages.text:
You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.

Allow your mount to rest for the night.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text:
The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.

Out in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

passages.title: Wolf Training: Orc Hunters
passages.text: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.

passages.title: Rest and Relaxation
passages.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!

passages.title: Rest and Relaxation
passages.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text:
The inn provides a perfect place for adventurers to take a rest between their travels. It's also a great place to talk them into joining our cause over a few rounds of drinks.

Go through my selection and let's see if we can obtain a new recruit. I'll give you a little something as a finder's fee for your efforts.

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text: Find a recruit that you like?

passages.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
passages.text:
Ahh, I'm glad you were able to find a good hire!

I'll get back to looking for more candidates for you. Check back in every week to see my latest selections.

passages.title: The Black Claw
passages.text: Behind me, as ye can probably see, is a giant black claw. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.

passages.title: The Black Claw
passages.text:
Like I said, the claw has a strange effect on the mounts we've got here. If ye have it with ye when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.

Should ye find the training not rough enough, ye might want to challenge yourself.

I'd have a pretty hefty prize for anyone that could manage that!

passages.title: Teeth of a Predator
passages.text: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything!

passages.title: Teeth of a Predator
passages.text:
I've not seen the beasts go so wild in all of my years, as the day we brought this thing back to the stables.

Should ye find the training still not hard enough, take it along with ye. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.

Be careful! I'd give a prize to anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I don't want to see you wind up dead!

passages.title: The Black Claw
passages.text: You've probably seen this enormous, black claw in our pile of supplies. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.

passages.title: The Black Claw
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Black Claw
passages.text:
This claw has a strange effect on the mounts we have. If you have it with you when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.

Should you find the training not rough enough, you might want to challenge yourself further by carrying it with you.

I think besting the beasts of Draenor with it would certainly be worthy of a reward.

passages.title: Teeth of a Predator
passages.text: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything.

passages.title: Teeth of a Predator
passages.text:
I have not seen the beasts go so mad in all of my years as a sage, as the day we brought this necklace  back to the stables.

Should you find the training still not hard enough, take it along with you. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.

Be careful! I would gladly reward anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I do not want to see you wind up dead!

passages.title: Unwelcome Memories
passages.text:
The botani in the Everbloom Wilds are doin' some sorta foul magic to create these plant... well... zombies, basically.

I've seen what happens with armies o' mindless slaves. The Lich King...

<Delvar's eyes close.>

No matter. We cannae let this escalate any further. I heard o' a particularly nasty one they've just made... let's kill it and see what makes it tick.

passages.title: Unwelcome Memories
passages.text: No zombies, plant o' otherwise, are goin' ta walk this world if ol' Delvar has anythin' to say about it.

passages.title: Unwelcome Memories
passages.text: I'll be takin' a close look at this... thing. We can't have a repeat o' Northrend.

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text:
When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements.

One day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis.

Master, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.

passages.title: Go Fetch
passages.text:
Now THIS is a savage land worthy of my level of heroism!

Oh, hello, I did not see you standing there, staring at me. Perhaps you have noticed that every piece of my armor is an ancient relic, forgotten by time.

As you have properly surmised, an adventurer of my stature does not have time to complete the menial requests I am given daily. I must remain here, yelling aloud to the trade district so that others may witness my heroicness and be inspired.

Today I require a Nightmare Bell, do find one.

passages.title: Go Fetch
passages.text: What do you want?

passages.title: Go Fetch
passages.text: I see you have completed this menial task admirably, almost as if you were intended to experience such a thing. Ah fate, what do you have in store for me next?

passages.title: Sky Dancers
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>, and I thank you for your hospitality.

The Shado-pan have sent several warriors to aid against the Iron Horde, however we can. We are few, though, and they are many.

The arakkoa in the south are both beautiful and deadly. They appear lighter than air, their attacks a deadly dance that flits from opponent to opponent.

The winds are on their side, as the four winds lighten the steps of my own allies. Bring me a sample of their winds, if you are able. It will surely aid us.

passages.title: Sky Dancers
passages.text: Did you find the fifth wind?

passages.title: Sky Dancers
passages.text: I will take this to the Shado-pan right away. Fortune be with you, we will have need of your help again when the winds run quiet.

passages.title: For the Birds
passages.text:
Hi! Have you ever held a peachick hatchling?

<Without warning, Mylune grabs both of your hands and then stuffs a tiny chirping bird in them.>

Isn't it so small and light and downy? Like you're holding a beaky peepy lil' CLOUD! It's so adorable you can't help but hug it and cuddle it and stuff regurgitated food in its teeny-tiny mouth.

<name>, the plantfolk in the Everbloom are turning peachicks into monsters before they can grow into beautiful swans. Or whatever they grow into. Please help them!

passages.title: For the Birds
passages.text:
Have you rescued a peachick? We're all they have, and those awful plant creatures are doing terrible things to them!

<Mylune's voice suddenly drops two octaves and sends a chill up your spine.>

Terrible. Things.

passages.title: For the Birds
passages.text:
<Mylune gently lifts the tiny little bird to her face, nuzzling it. It crawls onto her shoulder and disappears into her nest of green hair. A moment later, a beautiful fan of brightly-colored tailfeathers emerges from the top of her head.>

<Mylune's bright blue eyes grow moist with tears and her mouth goes slack with adoration. You've made the dryad VERY happy.>

passages.title: Cold Steel
passages.text:
Do you know what I want? What everyone who came through that portal wants. Every soldier running from a world that didn't understand us, didn't need us. I want that world to love us as much as we love it.

But we don't really belong there, not anymore. War is part of us, and we can't go back. To everyone back there, we're expendable.

The only thing that makes me feel better now is the feel of a cold iron cannon in my hands, pointed at the enemy.

<Keeshan stares into his mug of ale.>

passages.title: Cold Steel
passages.text: Leave me alone.

passages.title: Cold Steel
passages.text:
Yeah, this will do nicely. I'm going to run out of ammo, but at least I've got something to live for, for a while.

Here, kid, you're gonna need this more than I am.

passages.title: Cro's Revenge
passages.text:
HA! The fruit vendor was so cunning, but I, Cro Threadstrong, am even MORE cunning. I have come back into the past to defeat the ogre army before that fruit vendor can turn them against me!

Bring me the head of a big, strong ogre from the old slag mines, and I will have crushed the fruit vendor before a single apple has even grown!

CAN YOU HEAR ME, FRUIT VENDOR? I WILL HAVE MY VICTORY!

passages.title: Cro's Revenge
passages.text: THE FRUIT VENDOR STANDS NO CHANCE!

passages.title: Cro's Revenge
passages.text:
Revenge has the sweetest taste. Like an apple.

Take this, friend. May all of your fruit be CRUSHED INTO PULP LIKE YOUR ENEMIES.

passages.title: Time-Lost Vikings
passages.text:
Oi, barely made it out of that place!

We came through the portal to help, and the next thing you know, we're prisoners in the Bloodmaul Slag Mine. It was brutal! We were shackled for days, and covered in filth.

And they took my SHIELD!

passages.title: Time-Lost Vikings
passages.text: <Olaf sobs.>

passages.title: Time-Lost Vikings
passages.text: Oi, it's a fair sight dirtier, but that's her! Here, this is for you. You have my thanks.

passages.title: The Cure For Death
passages.text:
Greetings, and my thanks for the warmth of this inn and your hospitality.

As you can see, this malady of death continues to plague me. My studies on Azeroth and in Northrend met with little luck, and all of my leads ran dry.

I have come to Draenor in the hope of finding something, anything, to go on. My first pilgrimage will be to Auchindoun, a house where souls are put at ease.

If you should head there yourself, do let me know if you should happen upon anything of interest.

passages.title: The Cure For Death
passages.text: Did you find anything?

passages.title: The Cure For Death
passages.text:
This... may help me. I will need to return to Light's Hope shortly, you have my thanks.

I will not need these supplies any longer, they are yours.

passages.title: The Brass Compass
passages.text:
Greetings, commander. I have come on a mission directly from the captain.

Aboard any vessel on Azeroth that's manned by at least one orc, you'll hear sea shanties sung about a device capable of navigating the broad, rough ocean of Draenor. The orcs used it to keep their heading true in the choppiest of storms.

Perhaps it's just an old sea tale, but this one chance to find that kind of prize has the captain willing to part with some fine treasure.

passages.title: The Brass Compass
passages.text: Did you find the compass?

passages.title: The Brass Compass
passages.text: This might just be what we were looking for. Here's your booty.

passages.title: The Soulcutter
passages.text:
Don't look at me! Who do you think you are?

You and I are on the same side, you know. The necromancers here, we have to kill them. All of them.

Don't you agree?

Of course you do, and you can help me accomplish this goal. Find a Soulsever Blade in that hovel where the necromancers have holed up like rats. It has... special properties... that will aid us against the undead.

passages.title: The Soulcutter
passages.text: Did you find the blade?

passages.title: The Soulcutter
passages.text:
Excellent, most excellent.

I will wear it down quickly, and it cannot be repaired due to its unique nature. Expect to hear from me again.

passages.title: Gloriously Incandescent
passages.text:
I did not come here to fight, I have seen too many die already. I have killed so many with my own hands.

I have come to seek the light, and redemption.

The arakkoa of this land worship the sun as I do. But they are a violent, isolationist, and decadent race, who seem to derive a different message than my own people. This troubles me.

Bring me one of their Sun Crystals. I wish to see this light.

passages.title: Gloriously Incandescent
passages.text: Did you find the crystal?

passages.title: Gloriously Incandescent
passages.text:
The sun, I can see it. It is so bright.

I... wish to be alone. Take this, and my thanks.

passages.title: Aviana's Request
passages.text:
The arakkoa are creatures of the sky, and are thus within the domain of the great Aviana.

I have been sent to procure a feather, that we may parley with them through the language of the winds. We will extend an invitation of peace, and a place on the Great Bough.

Would you aid us in this quest? The feather must come from an arakkoan of nobility. You will find them in the place known as Skyreach.

passages.title: Aviana's Request
passages.text: Did you bring a feather?

passages.title: Aviana's Request
passages.text:
My thanks, <name>. Aviana will be pleased, and we may yet be able to aid you.

Aviana has sought fit to bless you with this, use it well.

passages.title: Cleaving Time
passages.text:
I, Gamon, have come through the dark portal to cleave many orc skulls. Yet my weapon has not kept pace with my rage, and is nicked and dull.

Find me a new weapon - one that is good for removing Hellscream limbs.

passages.title: Cleaving Time
passages.text: What?

passages.title: Cleaving Time
passages.text: I like this blade. It will see me through much removing of limbs. Here, for you, something to remember me by.

passages.title: Family Traditions
passages.text:
He ran off with it! Oh what am I going to do, what am I going to DO?

My son, and my knife, they ran off to Blackrock Spire! Well, the knife didn't run, I suppose. That doesn't matter!

You've got to get it back! Yes, the knife! You've got to get me back my knife!

Go! Now! Stop talking!

passages.title: Family Traditions
passages.text: Where's my knife?

passages.title: Family Traditions
passages.text: You found it! It's safe! I was so worried! Take this, take it!

passages.title: Damsels and Dragons
passages.text:
What ho, squire <name>! Forgive my lips, as they bear gravest news. Dragons have taken up stinking residence within the hallowed halls of Blackrock Spire!

These great wyrms hold a distressed damsel in their scaly graspers. Her name is Zaela, they say. Such a beautiful name!

As my squire, it is your Light-given duty to adventure yourself into this spire and procure evidence of these dragons, lest I waste my heroism on a dragonless quest.

passages.title: Damsels and Dragons
passages.text: Did you find evidence of dragons?

passages.title: Damsels and Dragons
passages.text:
This is dire evidence indeed! I shall head there presently, to slay no less than twenty of the great beasts.

For Doloria!

passages.title: Cenarion Concerns
passages.text:
Ey mon!

De Cenarion Circle sent Zen'kiki out here ta check out dem primals. I woulda been here sooner, but I had a little bit o' trouble gettin' my flight form ta work, mon.

De plants in dis place... I can hear dem talk. Dey be yellin' all the time. Angry an' violent yellin'.

Would ya bring Zen'kiki back a leaf from dis Everbloom place dey be talkin' about? Maybe I can figure out what dey want.

passages.title: Cenarion Concerns
passages.text: Did ya have much luck, mon?

passages.title: Cenarion Concerns
passages.text:
Dis... is no good. Dey want to consume da whole planet. How did dey get so angry? What happened to dem? I'm gonna bring dis back to da Circle, we probably gonna need your help again soon.

One of dem fronds be a bit magical, you hold onto it for a bit.

passages.title: Titanic Evolution
passages.text:
Ah, hello! Do not look so surprised! Did I not also brave the dangers of the Mogu'shan Vaults? I am more sturdy than I look!

I have learned many things of this wonderful place in history already. Did you know that, just like on our world, the titans once came to this place?

At least, that is what I believe! Surely there are signs of the titans' presence here, even now. Should you find one, I would very much like to see it!

passages.title: Titanic Evolution
passages.text: Have you found any signs of the titans here?

passages.title: Titanic Evolution
passages.text:
This is precisely what I was hoping for! I shall begin to study it immediately.

While you were away, I collected these pretty flowers for you!

passages.title: And No Maces!
passages.text:
There are far too many bright-eyed young rogues being sent through this portal and off to war. If I'm going to start up my academy again, some of them have got to survive this little excursion.

While I'm here, I figured I might as well use the opportunity to gather some supplies for my grand opening. You can't start a business without plenty of daggers, after all.

Grab me a crate of weaponry from the Grimrail Depot, there should be plenty lying around. I'll have something nice for you.

passages.title: And No Maces!
passages.text: Did you find me some weapons?

passages.title: And No Maces!
passages.text:
Yes, these will do nicely. My thanks, and here is your reward.

Try not to die, I may need you again.

passages.title: Call of the Talon King
passages.text:
adventurer, you have done much for my people. I wish to thank you on their behalf.

Please visit Veil Terokk when you can.

passages.title: Call of the Talon King
passages.text: Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text:
When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements.

One day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis.

Master, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.

passages.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
passages.text: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.

passages.title: The Critical Path
passages.text:
The auburn forests of Talador sit at a critical crossroads of this continent, commander. The Iron Horde's fleet is already en route from Gorgrond to Shattrath on the west coast.

Talador will fall if we don't reinforce them. I took the liberty of dispatching Foreman Eksos, who has already begun construction on an outpost for your forces not far from the Iron Horde landing point. He awaits your orders sir.

passages.title: The Critical Path
passages.text: I won't waste any of your time, sir. Let us discuss strategy.

passages.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
passages.text:
Commander, good to see you. With the fall of the rangari base at Telaar, Vindicator Yrel, recommended that we establish a new foothold in Nagrand.

I've taken the liberty of dispatching some of our men and supplies. Rangari D'kaan's already reporting that the outpost is nearly complete. He asked me to let you know they are ready for you.

A gryphon is waiting to catch you up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you're ready, <sir/ma'am>.

passages.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
passages.text:
They came at us... from... nowhere.

<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

passages.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
passages.text:
The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it.

Perhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.

passages.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
passages.text:
<Lieutenant Thorn handles the weapon, her keen eyes taking note of every line, edge, and scratch. After several moments, she speaks.>

Magnificent.

This blade was honed by a master craftsman, and imbued with ancient magic.

Just imagine if such a powerful weapon were placed in the hands of a skilled warrior...

passages.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
passages.text:
The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it.

Perhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.

passages.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
passages.text:
<Warmaster Zog lifts the blade into the air, admiring its balance and heft.>

Never have I seen a weapon such as this. It was clearly made by a master, imbued with ancient magic, and tested in many a battle.

Commander, I will leave the choice to you, but it would be an honor to see this blade placed in service of this garrison.

passages.title: Cymre Brightblade
passages.text: I found some interesting artifacts on a recent dig, and I'd love to put them through their paces to see how they would have performed in their native cultures. Don't suppose you have anything small and furry that can put up a fight?

passages.title: Cymre Brightblade
passages.text: Did you want to pet battle or just talk...

passages.title: Cymre Brightblade
passages.text: Thanks for helping me test out these artifacts.

passages.title: Ashlei
passages.text: I don't really like when my pets fight, but I love making them feel better when they're done.

passages.title: Ashlei
passages.text: Hi.

passages.title: Ashlei
passages.text: That was fun.

passages.title: Rekindling an Old Flame
passages.text:
I am dying, <race>. My flame, it smolders... soon my light will flicker and fade into nothing.

You mustn't allow this. Retrieve for me the Essence of Flame. Allow me to live another day and I will burn every breaker to ash, I swear it.

I will take vengeance for my brothers and sisters.

passages.title: Rekindling an Old Flame
passages.text: Do you have it, <name>? Will you kindle my flame?

passages.title: Rekindling an Old Flame
passages.text: The flames, they burn within me!

passages.title: Gargra
passages.text: Do you wish to offer challenge? My wolves must train to become strong.

passages.title: Gargra
passages.text: My wolves grow restless.

passages.title: Gargra
passages.text: You have helped my pups train, and for that I give thanks.

passages.title: Tarr the Terrible
passages.text: Tarr is the true warlord! Bring your army to fight and I show you.

passages.title: Tarr the Terrible
passages.text: Tarr destroy your face!

passages.title: Tarr the Terrible
passages.text: You lucky this time.

passages.title: Vesharr
passages.text: I had a vision with one who had mastered pets came to challenge me. Has the vision finally come to pass?

passages.title: Vesharr
passages.text: Can you defeat me?

passages.title: Vesharr
passages.text: The feathers have fallen and shown us much.

passages.title: Taralune
passages.text: I strive to teach through non-lethal pet battle. Are you willing to learn?

passages.title: Taralune
passages.text: You have not yet learned enough.

passages.title: Taralune
passages.text: We have learned from each other.  Thank you.

passages.title: Cold Steel Part II
passages.text:
Hey, you.

I wanted to thank you for what you did for me. The feel of that cannon in my hands is all the therapy I'll ever need. But now...

<Keeshan stares off into the distance and grimaces.>...I'm all out of bullets.

Guess I'll just sit here and wait to die.

passages.title: Cold Steel Part II
passages.text: Leave me alone.

passages.title: Cold Steel Part II
passages.text: Ah, that's the stuff. I'm going to run out of ammo, but at least I've got something to live for, for a while.

passages.title: The Search Continues
passages.text:
An old deckhand inspected that device you brought us, and thinks it was quite the forgery. This Iron Horde is trying to copy the mechanism, but they don't quite have the technology.

When you get right down to it, we're not sure how these primitive beasts got a hold of this kind of tool. Wouldn't be half as good of a sea tale if we knew, ha!

We've still got a pile of treasure with your name on it, if you can find us the real compass.

passages.title: The Search Continues
passages.text: Did you find the compass?

passages.title: The Search Continues
passages.text: Let's hope this is the real thing, every time I go through that portal I feel my fur stand on end.

passages.title: Soulcarver Voss
passages.text:
You! You're the one that found me the blade, correct? I have need of your services again.

The blade worked wonderfully, allowing me to sever the tormented undead from this world. Their screams were such beautiful music.

However, the Soulsever Blade cannot be repaired, as it is partially woven with spirit energy that is drawn upon each time a soul is released. I need another, as there are still dark forces at work in this place, raising spirits and turning them.

passages.title: Soulcarver Voss
passages.text: Did you find the blade?

passages.title: Soulcarver Voss
passages.text:
Yes, yes this is perfect. It is time, little souls, to return to the twisting darkness.

<Lilian cackles madly.>

passages.title: Vessel of Virtue
passages.text:
Hello, again, commander. This plague yet vexes me, but I shall remain resolute, with the light as my guide.

The Soulweave Vessel has aided our investigations into the world beyond and the transition from life to death. With more vessels, we may be able to discover the truth behind the bridge between worlds. Perhaps there is a reason why the scourged do not fully make this transition.

Any additional help would be greatly appreciated by the Argent Dawn.

passages.title: Vessel of Virtue
passages.text: Did you find anything?

passages.title: Vessel of Virtue
passages.text: Once again, though I will need to return to Light's Hope shortly, you have my most sincere thanks.

passages.title: The Dark Within
passages.text:
The light... has gone out. I know not why.

I am more troubled now than before. I can find little comfort in the everyday. Each day seems darker than the last.

Please, bring me another one of the Sun Crystals. Its light is so warm, so comforting.

passages.title: The Dark Within
passages.text: Did you find the crystal?

passages.title: The Dark Within
passages.text: The warmth comforts me. I thank you.

passages.title: A Plea to the Sky
passages.text:
We have, so far, been unsuccessful in our attempts to contact the arakkoa. Each attempt strips the plumage, and we are left with a feather that is tattered and broken.

Aviana implores you, commander, to find another plume for her. We do not wish to see our brethren become victim of their own violent nature. All beings of the sky have a place with us, in life or beyond.

passages.title: A Plea to the Sky
passages.text: Did you bring a feather?

passages.title: A Plea to the Sky
passages.text:
We will continue to attempt to parlay with the arakkoa.

Aviana's blessing upon you.

passages.title: A Hero's Quest is Never Complete
passages.text:
What ho, squire <name>! Since last we spoke, I have heroically approached the gates of Blackrock Spire and nobly intended to end the toothy reign of its dragons.

Yet, as I neared the place, my mind drifted to thoughts of my Doloria's fair face, and to my own painfully unsatisfied desires.

My sword arm fell limp at my side.

I charge THEE then, squire, to go in my stead and search Upper Blackrock Spire. I must know if the dragons still squirm within its corridors.

passages.title: A Hero's Quest is Never Complete
passages.text: Did you find evidence of dragons?

passages.title: A Hero's Quest is Never Complete
passages.text:
By the light, they breed like great fiery rabbits! I shall head there presently, to slay no less than THIRTY of the great beasts.

For Doloria!

passages.title: An Axe to Grind
passages.text:
I, Gamon, have cleaved many orc skulls. Yet many of the iron horde remain, full of limbs and blood. I will relieve them of these things!

Or I would, if I had an axe. The last one broke in half in the middle of an orc's ribcage.

<Gamon laughs heartily.>

Bring me another, so that I may continue cleaving my way through this land!

passages.title: An Axe to Grind
passages.text: What?

passages.title: An Axe to Grind
passages.text: A mighty blade, but I will wear it out quickly. Orc heads are harder than they look.

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: I'd like you to do some training. Head out and test your skill against the trainers in Draenor.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. May the souls of Auchindoun remain at peace with the threat of Teron'gor eliminated.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Eliminating Skylord Tovra's rylak escorts and disrupting the Grimrail will save an innumerable amount of lives.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Taking down one of Draenor's great giants is regrettable, but letting Skullok, Son of Gruul, remain a tool of the Iron Horde would have led to great distruction.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. If not for you, all of Draenor may have withered under High Sage Viryx's rule.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Your efforts to stop Yalnu may not only have saved our outpost but all of Azeroth as well.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Warlord Zaela
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Warlord Zaela
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Defeating the Ironmarch Vanguard at Upper Blackrockspire is a major blow to the Iron Horde and Azeroth can rest a bit more knowing Warlord Zaela's bid for revenge has been permanently dealt with.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. May the souls of Auchindoun remain at peace with the threat of Teron'gor eliminated.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Gug'rokk
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a formidable group and head into the depths of the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and free the miners of Gug'rokk's tyrannical rule.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Gug'rokk
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. The families of the rescued miners will never be able to thank you enough for eliminating Gug'rokk and his slavers.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Eliminating Skylord Tovra's rylak escorts and disrupting the Grimrail will save an innumerable amount of lives.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Taking down one of Draenor's great giants is regrettable, but letting Skullok, Son of Gruul, remain a tool of the Iron Horde would have led to great distruction.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. If not for you, all of Draenor may have withered under High Sage Viryx's rule.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. Your efforts to stop Yalnu may not only have saved our outpost but all of Azeroth as well.

passages.title: Da Big Score
passages.text: I know, I know. I be givin' ya these for ya treasures, but now I be wantin' dem back. It be complicated, mon. Do ya want da gold or not?

passages.title: Da Big Score
passages.text: So you've got them?

passages.title: Da Big Score
passages.text: Oh, ya got dem for me? Excellent. Here's ya money.

passages.title: Cleaning House
passages.text:
Not long ago, a new recruit showed up by the name o' Jacob Anders. He's been trouble since he got here, always drinkin' and pickin' fights, but he crossed the line this time.

One o' our patrols spotted him tradin' intel with the Horde - he's a traitor, commander! I thought ye would want tae deal with him personally.

He was out drinkin' by the water last time I saw him, and I'd bet me pappy's beard he's still there.

passages.title: Cleaning House
passages.text: I think ye did the right thing, commander.

passages.title: Resources in Ashran
passages.text:
Bodrick has mentioned to me that you have acquired some interesting construction notes in your forays out there. A construction guide or assembly notes perhaps?

You should speak with Kinkade Jacobs in Stormshield. She is willing to exchange finished blueprints for such things.

passages.title: Resources in Ashran
passages.text:
Oh you have some blueprint texts for me? That's great!

Let's do some business!

passages.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
passages.text:
Your arrival couldn't be more timely, commander.

Shadowmoon raiders have been spotted closing in on the garrison.

You repelled their advances at Teluuna Observatory, and created chaos at Shaz'gul.

Now, they surely seek retribution. They will throw everything they have at us.

I have the entire garrison on high alert. Are you ready to face them?

passages.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
passages.text: Time to shine a light on these shadows!

passages.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
passages.text: I don't think they were ready for that. The Shadowmoon will think twice before attacking us again.

passages.title: Upgrades in Ashran
passages.text:
You got some construction guides or assembly notes on ya? Oh man that's good news!

I know this guy in Ashran, goes by Torgg Flexington. He's got finished blueprints we need!

Go talk to this guy and bring back some good stuff for us to build, ok?

passages.title: Upgrades in Ashran
passages.text: Oh YEAH buddy! We can work something out. I got plenty of stuff for you to buy!

passages.title: Thunderlord Invasion!
passages.text:
Your timing could not have been better.

Your scouts have reported the approach of a large Thunderlord army.

My clan can ride out and assist in severing their reinforcements, but you will need to see to the defense of your fort against the bulk of their forces.

Sergeant Grimjaw awaits your command.

passages.title: Thunderlord Invasion!
passages.text: The Frostwolves stand ready.

passages.title: Thunderlord Invasion!
passages.text: Well fought, commander. Now to strike back before the Thunderlord can recover.

passages.title: Not In Your Army
passages.text:
Your men caught one of da new recruits, talking with da alliance behind your back. She be a traitor, boss-mon! She be a danger to everything you've worked so hard for.

We have a wyvern ready to be takin' her to your garrison for proper punishment. I thought you would be wantin' to deal with da scoundrel personally.

I last be seein' her on the back road out of Axefall.

passages.title: Not In Your Army
passages.text: Is da traitor ready to leave, commander?

passages.title: Not In Your Army
passages.text: You be makin' the right call, commander. There be no room for her kind in your ranks.

passages.title: Clearing the Mist
passages.text:
<The troll's skin looks pale. Beads of sweat dot his brow.>

I know you owe me nouting, but if you be willin' ta help me, I have a favor to ask.

Ta da north, dere be da creature dat is da cause a' dis poisonous mist.

Only da heart a' dis beast has da power ta neutralize da toxins in my body.

Ya may have ta kill some a dose crawlers while you're at it.

If ya feel weak from da poison, eat some a dose glowing mushrooms ta counter da effects.

passages.title: Clearing the Mist
passages.text: I ain't feelin' so good.

passages.title: Clearing the Mist
passages.text: Yes! Dat be da heart! You did it...

passages.title: A Lack of Wasps
passages.text:
The stings! These cursed wasps drone day and night and their constant aggression taxes me so.

I shall do nothing about your offer until these nuisances are dealt with.

passages.title: A Lack of Wasps
passages.text: Wasps are truly despicable things.

passages.title: A Lack of Wasps
passages.text: Perhaps my rituals will be undisturbed for a few nights at least. Your offer is intriguing and I think we can come to an agreement.

passages.title: Silver Victory
passages.text:
The was a good fight, Commander. It might give me time to clean my sword.

And honor our fallen.

passages.title: The Dead Do Not Forget...
passages.text:
Many years ago my family and I were slain in this very spot.

The saberon you see around you are descended from the tribe that murdered my village. Long have I waited, here in this forgotten place, to see justice brought to the saberon for their crimes.

The Snarlpaw chief is a boneseer, a saberon who divines the future using the remains of the dead.

Collect the ancient skulls of the Snarlpaw ancestors and place them in the boneseer's cauldron.

Let their own bones fill their cauldron for once!

passages.title: The Dead Do Not Forget...
passages.text: <The cauldron bubbles and boils.>

passages.title: The Dead Do Not Forget...
passages.text:
<The boiling cauldron gasps and spurts boiling liquid with each skull that is plunged into the pot.>

<As the last of the skulls is submerged within the bubbling cauldron, you feel the sharp nip of a ghostly breeze upon your skin.>

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Wedding Bands
passages.text: We've been asked to craft a pair of wedding bands. The clients requested that they be made by you.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Wedding Bands
passages.text: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Wedding Bands
passages.text: These are beautiful. The bride and groom will be well pleased.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Fine Choker
passages.text:
We have a request for a fine necklace. The client wants to give it to an old enemy, to end the conflict. She didn't specify a design, but I think I heard her mumbling under her breath about a choker. 

Oh, and she asks that the chain be "extra sturdy".

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Fine Choker
passages.text: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Fine Choker
passages.text: Wonderful. The client was just talking about how she couldn't wait to put it around her rival's neck. I'm sure they won't be in conflict anymore after this gift.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Yellow Brighter Than Gold
passages.text: We've been commissioned to make a gold bracelet, set with a taladite crystal "even brighter than gold". I can handle the metal work, but the crystal isn't something I can do.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Yellow Brighter Than Gold
passages.text: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Yellow Brighter Than Gold
passages.text: This is beautiful.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Blue the Shade of Sky and Sea
passages.text: The client wants a pair of silver earrings, set with blue crystals to match her eyes. The metal work is simple enough, but I don't know how to create such a shade of taladite.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Blue the Shade of Sky and Sea
passages.text: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.

passages.title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Blue the Shade of Sky and Sea
passages.text: These are perfect. I almost feel like my settings aren't worthy of such gems.

passages.title: Out of Stock: Blackrock Ore
passages.text: Our latest bracelet design is selling like mad, but we are completely out of the blackrock to make them.

passages.title: Out of Stock: Blackrock Ore
passages.text: Unless we get more blackrock ore, we will not be able to fill the orders.

passages.title: Out of Stock: Blackrock Ore
passages.text: Thank you.

passages.title: Out of Stock: True Iron Ore
passages.text: It seems our little boutique is gaining a reputation. We use true iron in all our designs, and guess what: we're out!

passages.title: Out of Stock: True Iron Ore
passages.text: We are fortunate that our jewelry is so popular, but we won't be able to make more without any true iron.

passages.title: Out of Stock: True Iron Ore
passages.text: We are back in business!

passages.title: Befriending the Locals
passages.text:
We need allies desperately if we want a chance at surviving until tomorrow. We've made contact with one of the outcast arakkoa, but he refused to discuss alliances without speaking to you first.

He called himself Dusk-Seer Irrizar. You should speak with him, commander.

You can find him just southwest of Veil Terokk.

passages.title: Befriending the Locals
passages.text: Ah, so you are the one your people spoke of so highly. We may discuss an alliance, but first...

passages.title: Befriending the Locals
passages.text:
Commander, I believe it best for the safety of this outpost if we secure an ally. We've made contact with one of the outcast arakkoa, but he refused to make any promises of alliance without speaking to you first.

He called himself Dusk-Seer Irrizar. Could you go speak with him, commander?

You can find him just southwest of Veil Terokk.

passages.title: Befriending the Locals
passages.text: Ah, so you are the one your people spoke of so highly. We may discuss an alliance, but first...

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon.

For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
Excellent. We have more immediate concerns to deal with until he visits.

Dark Ranger Velonara requires your immediate attention, sir.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon.

For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
Excellent. We have more immediate concerns to deal with until he visits.

Hulda Shadowblade requires your immediate attention, sir.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon.

For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text: Well done, commander.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text:
I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon.

For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now
passages.text: Well done, sir.

passages.title: Feast of the Spires
passages.text:
Boss-mon, I prepared a great feast for you right over dere. You should be havin' a bite or two before you be goin' out for da day.

Trust me, you will feel much betta if you do!

passages.title: Feast of the Spires
passages.text:
Commander, I prepared a great feast for ye right over there. You should be have a bite o' two before you be go out fer the day.

Trust me, it's good fer ya!

passages.title: Fully Armed and Operational
passages.text:
Commander! Great news! Now that the workshop is fully armed and operational, we can start cranking out siege weapons just as soon as we have the resources.

The Overcharged Demolisher is the pinnacle of goblin engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average demolisher, and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis.

As soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

passages.title: Fully Armed and Operational
passages.text:
Can't wait to get this thing up and running for you, commander!

Check back in tomorrow, and be sure to wear your blast goggles!

passages.title: Fully Armed and Operational
passages.text:

The Overcharged Siege Engine is the pinnacle of gnomish engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average siege engine and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis.

As soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

passages.title: Fully Armed and Operational
passages.text: We're going to need resources if you want us to create a siege weapon!

passages.title: Fully Armed and Operational
passages.text:
Can't wait to get this thing up and running for you, commander!

Check back in tomorrow, and be sure to wear your blast goggles!

passages.title: Basics First
Dizzy Sparkshift
passages.text:
I'm in a pretty good spot as far as artifacts go.

We have a couple other society members out in the field. I'd go look for them, but it seems like a bad idea from a health perspective.

You don't seem to have a problem with pain, think you could find Dizzy?

passages.title: Dizzy Sparkshift
passages.text: Shh... keep it down. The last thing I want is to get punched in the face by an ogre.

passages.title: News for Nixxie
passages.text:
Nixxie is probably worried sick about the potential loss of profits from this surveying operation.

If you see her can you let her know we will be back soonish?

passages.title: News for Nixxie
passages.text:
It sounds like the excavation of Broken Precipice is going to be fully operational in no time.

I can't wait to line my pockets with some of that sweet moolah.

Nixxie is probably worried sick about the potential loss of profits from this surveying operation.

If you see her can you let her know we will be back soonish?

passages.title: News for Nixxie

It sounds like the excavation of Broken Precipice is going to be fully operational in no time.

I can't wait to line my pockets with some of that sweet moolah.

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
passages.text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

passages.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
passages.text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: You know the drill. Defeat the pets in the garrison, and I might have something for you.

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: You've earned this!

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: You know the drill. Defeat the pets in the garrison, and I might have something for you.

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Mastering the Menagerie
passages.text: You've earned this!

passages.title: Building for Professions
Building for Professions
passages.text: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

passages.title: Building for Professions
passages.text: How is it coming along?

passages.title: Building for Professions
passages.text: Congratulations!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
passages.text:
I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?

<Reshad's voice drops to a whisper>

There is movement in the shadows, we are being watched!

Take these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
passages.text: So the Shadow Council is involved? Interesting...
