passages.text:
I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?

<Reshad's voice drops to a whisper>

There is movement in the shadows, we are being watched!

Take these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
passages.text: Did you take care of our watchers?

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
passages.text: So the Shadow Council is involved? Interesting...

passages.title: Trials of Khadgar: Iron Maidens
Walled City: Brackenspore
passages.text:
The Iron Horde is just one of the threats we must deal with on Draenor. We must also clean up the chaos they are leaving in their wake.

Brackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. He spreads his fungal growth in his wake and will eradicate all of us if left unchecked.

Travel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore.

passages.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
passages.text: Very good, Commander! Brackenspore's infestation will not be spreadin' to da rest of Draenor.

passages.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
passages.text:
Forget all you know of the ogres on Azeroth, <name>. On Draenor they commanded a once-mighty civilization. Even now they threaten to reclaim their former glory.

Highmaul excavations in Nagrand unearthed a mysterious relic. The only ogre to survive direct exposure to this relic was Ko'ragh; he was left with a near-complete immunity to all magic.

Ko'ragh must be killed before the ogres learn to replicate his unique powers. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh!

passages.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
passages.text: Ko'ragh be defeated. You be as strong as dey say, commander. I be proud to be at your side.

passages.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
passages.text:
The conditions are ripe for a decisive attack against the Highmaul, commander. Will you engage?

Descended from a long line of sorcerers, Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. He is both cunning and brutal, and allied himself with the Iron Horde when he recognized what it would be to oppose them.

Travel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok. Without their leader, the Ogre Empire will descend into chaos for many years.

passages.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
passages.text: A brilliant victory, commander! Imperator Mar'gok be defeated. You indeed be a champion of da Horde!

passages.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
passages.text:
Commander. Frostwolf scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and they've coerced the beast into helping them to create their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."

We must destroy it, <name>. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Kromog.

passages.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
passages.text: Da defeat of Kromog will hinder da Iron Horde's operations within da Foundry.

passages.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
passages.text: Well done, commander! Not since Garrosh Hellscream commanded our forces in Northrend have I seen such decisive action.

passages.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
passages.text:
Our forces are making progress on land, but victory at sea still eludes us. We must take out the Iron Horde leadership while they are in harbor.

Gar'an, Admiral of the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called Iron Maidens, is tactically brilliant. She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have crushed all who have been sent to oppose them.

Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

passages.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
passages.text: Brilliant work, commander. Without da mind of Admiral Gar'an behind it, da Iron Horde's naval fleet be greatly diminished.

passages.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
passages.text:
Grommash Hellscream relied on the strength of his Warlords to keep the Iron Horde under his control. It is time to strike a decisive blow.

Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He is second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.

Travel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

passages.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
passages.text: One of da most ruthless orcs to walk any land be defeated. You be havin' my congratulations, and my thanks.

passages.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
passages.text:
If it ain't one threat, it's another - I swear this light-forsaken world would try to eat us alive even without no Horde to fight.

Brackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. That thing is already spreading like a disease, <name>. Ye got to put it down!

Travel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore before he gets too powerful to stop.

passages.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
passages.text: Excellent! Brackenspore's infestation will not spread to the rest of Draenor. Thank you, commander.

passages.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
passages.text:
Ye know the name "Ko'ragh?" One of them Highmaul ogres. They dug up a relic some time ago that killed everyone it touched but for Ko'ragh... givin' him a near-complete immunity to all magic.

Ogres ain't meant to have that kind of power! Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh, before they learn to use him against us.

passages.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
passages.text: Why would Ko'ragh remain a lackey to the sorcerer king despite his unique gifts? Ogres.

passages.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
passages.text: Great work! Ko'ragh is defeated. You truly are as powerful as they say.

passages.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
passages.text:
I never thought much of them ogres, not until I saw a Highmaul legion on the march. Like a wall o' armored muscle, backed by the magics o' the emperor's best sorcerers. Never underestimate an ogre.

Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. Aye, he's a cunning one - allied himself with the Iron Horde, he did. If we're to break up the party, we'd best start at the top.

Travel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok!

passages.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
passages.text: Well done! A great blow has been dealt this day.

passages.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
passages.text:
Yer garrison scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and that the filthy beast has begun helpin' those brutes churn out their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."

Travel to Blackrock Foundry and slay that fiend!

passages.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
passages.text: With Kromog defeated, we won't seeing as many Iron Horde machines rolling out to the front lines. You've saved a lot of lives today, commander.

passages.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
passages.text:
"If ye want to topple a wall, start with the foundation." It's an old Dwarf saying. If we take out the Iron Horde's leadership, the whole thing tumbles.

Gar'an is the Admiral o' the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called "Iron Maidens." She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have dominated the seas of Draenor.

No more, <name>. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

passages.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
passages.text: Great work, commander! We'll wrest control of the seas yet!

passages.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
passages.text:
Ol' Grommash cannot rule the Iron Horde without his Warlords keeping the clans in line. Let's deal 'em a blow that they can't recover from! Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He's second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.

Travel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

passages.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
passages.text: So it's done, then? The foundry is in shambles. We've delivered a mighty blow today, commander. Great work!

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text:
Foreman Eksos down in your Talador outpost figures he has the answer for why there's been so much seismic activity recently.

See, there's this giant, ah... earth fury, I think they're called, and it's covered in these powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. The crystals hum real loud and we think it's driving the fury crazy!

Problem is, nobody's got the firepower to take the thing down so we can examine a sample. Think you could lend us a hand, commander?

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text: Sir, what is that you have there?

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text: Excellent, this must be the crystal Eksos keeps talking about. We'll get top men studying this right away.

passages.title: Death to Gor'thul!
passages.text:
Saberon spirit army. I ain't pullin' your leg, commander, that's what we've got coming for us if we don't act fast.

The Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul was spotted down in Spires of Arak in the Bloodmane Pridelands right about the same time we started hearing reports of saberon spirits raiding our supply caravans.

I don't want to take any chances, commander. I think you should personally head down there and put a stop to this before it starts.

passages.title: Death to Gor'thul!
passages.text: Perfect, sir. I'm glad we won't have to worry about saberon spirits on top of everything else that's trying to murder us.

passages.title: Death to Undertow!
passages.text:
Good day to ya, commander!

I have bad news.

We've been contracting out some spy work to the local fisherman - we pay 'em some coin, they take their boats out north of Umbrafen and see what the Iron Horde's up to. Win-win, right?

Well, it turns out... no. Every boat that goes out never comes back. Apparently this giant water elemental, Undertow I think it was, is murdering the snot out of everyone that passes through.

Any chance you could clear it out for us, commander?

passages.title: Death to Undertow!
passages.text: Thank you, commander. We hope the intel we gather from the Tanaan Channel will prove very useful in the coming months.

passages.title: Auchindoun
passages.text:
Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devouring the countless souls within. We must not let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.

Enter the holy mausoleum of Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest of the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

passages.title: Auchindoun
passages.text: Another agent of Gul'dan be fallin' before your might, commander. Gul'dan will surely be tremblin' at the heels of our victory dis day.

passages.title: Grimrail Depot
passages.text:
We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion of troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protecting the inner city.

Skylord Tovra has taken to guarding the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

passages.title: Grimrail Depot
passages.text: Derailing da Grimrail be a mighty blow to da Iron Horde. It will take dem a great deal of time to amass more troops thanks to you.

passages.title: Iron Docks
passages.text:
The Iron Docks is one of the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicating imminent attack.

Skulloc, son of Gruul, was seen leaving the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It does not matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave.

passages.title: Iron Docks
passages.text: Without Skulloc and their precious docks, da Iron Horde be a wolf pack trapped within their own cave... unable to hunt.

passages.title: Skyreach
passages.text:
High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.

The arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.

passages.title: Skyreach
passages.text: Perhaps now da Adherents of Rukhmar will respect we 'lesser races'.

passages.title: The Everbloom
passages.text:
The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. In their infinite wisdom they built it in the heart of the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest of the genesaur - Yalnu.

The outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter of time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

passages.title: The Everbloom
passages.text: Dese wizards' deaths be punishment enough for their lack of foresight. We should be thankful dat we were able to stop da overgrowth before it reached our world.

passages.title: Treasure Contract: Gutrek's Cleaver
passages.text:
In Nagrand, the ogres tell of an ancient weapon called Gutrek's cleaver. I would very much like to study it.

A goblin treasure hunter by the name of Val Goldspade discovered the whereabouts of the weapon. Unfortunately, this goblin has gone missing somewhere in the Broken Precipice - probably after a run-in with the locals.

passages.title: The Everbloom
passages.text:
The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. Unfortunately they built it in the heart o' the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest o' the genesaur - Yalnu.

The outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter o' time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

passages.title: The Everbloom
passages.text: I wish we could have saved the mages' lives, but sadly it was not to be. We should be thankful that we were able to stop the overgrowth before it reached our world.

passages.title: Skyreach
passages.text:
High Sage Viryx has finished a devastatin' crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.

The arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison!

passages.title: Skyreach
passages.text: Perhaps now the Adherents of Rukhmar will respect we 'lesser races'.

passages.title: Iron Docks
passages.text:
The Iron Docks is one o' the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicatin' imminent attack.

Skulloc, son o' Gruul, was seen leavin' the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It doesn't matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave!

passages.title: Iron Docks
passages.text: Without Skulloc and their precious docks, the Iron Horde won't be launching any attacks for a good long time!

passages.title: Grimrail Depot
passages.text:
We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion o' troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protectin' the inner city.

Skylord Tovra has taken to guardin' the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

passages.title: Grimrail Depot
passages.text: Derailing the Grimrail is a mighty blow to the Iron Horde. It will take them a great deal of time to amass more troops thanks to you.

passages.title: Auchindoun
passages.text:
Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devourin' the countless souls within. We mustn't let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.

Enter the holy mausoleum o' Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest o' the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

passages.title: Auchindoun
passages.text: Well done, commander. Gul'dan will surely tremble at the heels of our victory this day.

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The First Piece
passages.text:
The journal points to the location of the pieces of Gutrek's Cleaver. It reads:

"The pommel was brought to the Broken Precipice, where it was to be housed in the skull of Gutrek's first kill. It looks like it was some manner of large beast that he fought in the big bone pit."

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Second Piece
passages.text:
The search for Gutrek's Cleaver continues. The journal reads:

"The hilt was to be buried in the marshlands, among the serpents whose poison claimed Gutrek's life. There's something here about covering it with a spiral stone, which is supposed to keep Gutrek's spirit at bay somehow."

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Final Piece
passages.text:
Only one piece remains. The journal reads:

"The final piece, Gutrek's blade, was to be displayed in a place of honor for all time overlooking the Ring of Blood. I don't think I've seen it there myself, but it says it's supposed to be somewhere where it has a clear view of every battle."

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text:
With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.

The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text: Did you find that old blade Dr. Jones was looking for?

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text:
This matches the description of what Dr. Jones was looking for. I'll make sure it makes it to him. 

Here is your reward, <class>.

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text:
Foreman Grobash in da Talador outpost figures he knows why der's been so much seismic activity recently.

Der be an earth fury called Amethon that be covered in powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. Da crystals' hummin' be drivin' da fury crazy!

We want a sample to see if we can figure out why da crystals are so powerful. I wouldn't be askin' ya if I thought anybody else could do it, commander.

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text: What be makin' that infernal racket? Is that the crystal from Amethon you be holdin'?

passages.title: Death to Amethon!
passages.text: You always be savin' da day, commander. Thank you.

passages.title: Death to Gor'thul!
passages.text:
We been hearin' 'bout some real, real bad voodoo in Spires of Arak, commander.

Da Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul be seen sneakin' about da spires the same time we be hearin' of saberon spirits attackin' our supply caravans and our arakkoa allies.

I think it best if we take no chances. You should deal with da shaman personally before dis matter gets out of hand.

passages.title: Death to Gor'thul!
passages.text: Da spirits smile upon ya, commander. Thank you for all you do.

passages.title: Death to Undertow!
passages.text:
We be havin' a problem, commander.

We been sendin' some small boats into the Tanaan Channel north of da Umbrafen in Shadowmoon ta spy on da Alliance base der as well as da Iron Horde in Tanaan Jungle.

Da problem is dat every boat we send out come back in pieces, if it come back at all. We think a water elemental called Undertow is da culprit.

I know you be busy, but destroyin' that creature would be very helpful to our efforts.

passages.title: Death to Undertow!
passages.text: Ey, commander. How you doin' dis fine day?

passages.title: Death to Undertow!
passages.text: A thousand thank yous, commander. Dis spyin' should prove valuable in da comin' months.

passages.title: Orb of Dominion
passages.text:
Gul'dan and his Shadow Council have their hooks embedded deep into Garona's soul. We've tried traditional magical methods and they haven't helped her. It's time to get unorthodox.

<Khadgar cracks his knuckles, his eyes flashing with a disturbing eagerness.>

I've just learned of a Shadow Council holdout hidden beneath the Draenei city of Elodor. They are using an Orb of Dominion to brainwash spies. Quickly! Assault the cave and recover the orb for me. We will turn this dark magic to our advantage.

passages.title: Orb of Dominion
passages.text:
<Khadgar's fingers glow in anticipation.>

The orb! Did you find it?

passages.title: Orb of Dominion
passages.text:
Hand it here - gently now - ah, do you feel it? Makes my skin crawl. It's watching us, <name>.

I have invited the Shadow Council into my house. Let's get this over with before this thing can cause any mischief.

passages.title: The Shadow War
passages.text:
The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above.

Khadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."

passages.title: The Shadow War
passages.text: Well done, <name>! I find it troubling that the Shadow Council is so entrenched in these hidden regions of Draenor. Gul'dan has kept himself busy.

passages.title: Breaking Badness
passages.text:
It is time to liberate Garona. I know what to do... I think. I'd like you to stay close in case anything goes wrong.

Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Breaking Badness
passages.text:
Garona remains shaken, but she is with us now. She is eager to plot revenge against her former master!

I shall consider forgiving her for stabbing me.

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The First Key
passages.text:
The Arakkoa research points to three "keys" that need to be activated in order to use the Apexis device. The first is located in Skettis. The text mentioning it reads:

"The first key is kept in the high reaches of upper Skettis. It lay where the dead can protect it from the talons of the unwanted."

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Second Key
passages.text:
The first point has been activated and two more remain. The second location is hinted at in the old outcast writing:

"Beneath the third fall of the great Skettis river lay the second key. May the ever-rushing waters sweep away those that might seek it."

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Final Key
passages.text:
One last key is required to access the Apexis device. The writings pertaining to its location read:

"The final key has been housed deep within the fungal caves where the river makes its final drop. Though the pale orcs that dwell there may be vile, they should prove a worthy deterrent."

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text:
Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible. 

The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text: Were you able to take the amulet from the arakkoa?

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text:
I'm glad to see this out of the claws of the Adherents of Rukhmar. 

I'll get this to Dr. Jones right away.

passages.title: Dark Grimoire: The Final Ingredient
passages.text:
The final ingredient to create Megacharge's bomb is a sizable quantity of demon's blood. 

Unfortunately, that's not something they're likely to give up easily...

passages.title: The Invasion of Tanaan
passages.text:
It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here.

Now that we have our transport, we can let Durotan and that Archmage of yours know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.

passages.title: The Invasion of Tanaan
passages.text: The landing was easier than I expected, but there is trouble ahead.

passages.title: Obstacle Course
passages.text:
It is strange that these docks were abandoned by the Iron Horde, but up ahead our scouts report trouble.

A set of Bleeding Hollow scavengers is busy looting the abandoned buildings to the northwest.

Further down the road orc cultists are doing... something... near the Dark Portal.

We should try to recover any orders or information as to what is going on here, then meet with our scouts further in...

passages.title: Obstacle Course
passages.text: It be good ta hear da road is safer, but here be another problem.

passages.title: Treasure Contract: The Thunderlord Sage
passages.text:
In Frostfire Ridge, a Thunderlord sage by the name of Argoram seems to have uncovered the whereabouts of a storied weapon, known to the orcs as Gronnsbane. 

He was last spotted headed into Magnarok. Find him and see if he can lead you to this relic.

passages.title: Clearing the Docks
passages.text:
Our salvage team thought these here docks would be abandoned, but they're crawlin' wit' remnants of the Iron Horde. Gul'dan's cronies are convertin' anyone they can and evacuatin' everyone to Tanaan Jungle.

Commander, if yeh can clear this place out, my team can salvage some of this equipment.

Plus, ev'ry orc yeh kill here is one less ta worry about in Tanaan!

passages.title: Maritime Salvage
passages.text:
It would go a bit faster if you could mark any bigger piles of resources you see while you are clearing those guys out.

Just drop this flag down and someone will be along directly!

passages.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
passages.text: A few of us snuck through before we was spotted, den de cannons started up. De small ones are no trouble, but de big one... we gonna need to take it out if we wanna get anyting through.

passages.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
passages.text: We be movin' supplies through here now. We finda good place to build!

passages.title: The Assault Base
passages.text: Nearby be a good place. Not too close to da enemy, but close enough for us to take some pressure off da boys in the west. Follow me.

passages.title: The Assault Base
passages.text: The easy part is done, now comes the hard part.

passages.title: Treasure Contract: The Infected Orc
passages.text:
In Gorgrond, the Laughing Skull clan has a legend of one called Skulltaker. His mask, known only as the Silent Skull, is legendary among the clan, and could help us learn more about them.

Until recently, he was thought to have vanished. Now it appears he has shown his face, so to speak, in Everbloom Wilds. The last orc to have seen him fell to the botani there, but may still have some clues on how you can find Skulltaker and recover the mask.

If the botani have him, he may not be cooperative.

passages.title: The Silent Skull: The First Reagent
passages.text:
Grinning Tolg was in the process of brewing an elixir that would allow him to communicate with the ravagers, whom the Skulltaker relies on to remain hidden.

The first ingredient, the leaves of the Shadethistle plant, can be found nearby. The journal reads:

"It rests in the shadows of the harsh Gorgrond sun. I saw some under standing stones near the black iron walls."

passages.title: The Silent Skull: The Second Reagent
passages.text:
The second ingredient to the elixir is a vine from the Bonethorn plant. The journal reads:

"I must find a vine of bonethorn, which grows in the bones of the ancient dead. I remember seeing the bones of a long-dead beast in the dry beds of the northern wilds. Its sun-parched skull would make a pleasant home for such a plant."

passages.title: The Silent Skull: The Third Reagent
passages.text:
The final component of the elixir is a handful of Steamcap mushrooms. The journal reads:

"The Crowfeeder said that they grow among the steam vents in the higher parts of the Everbloom. I have seen one such place above the northern hydra pools."

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text:
With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir. 

Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.

His mask should bring a hefty reward.

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text: This must be the cursed skull. Are you sure we should be touching it?

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text:
This definitely looks like no Laughing Skull mask I've seen before. I'll take it to Jones and see what he makes of it. 

He left me with this payment for you.

passages.title: To Gul'dan!
passages.text:
We must act quickly - Garona here tells me that Gul'dan is on the move. He is headed to the Path of Glory to meet with Grommash Hellscream.

We have to act while our intelligence is fresh! Hurry and meet us outside of Bladefury's Command in northern Talador. We won't be able to engage Gul'dan and the whole Iron Horde army on our own, but we may just learn something to use against them...

passages.title: To Gul'dan!
passages.text:
This place is absolutely crawling with guards. I don't know how Garona can be so confident.

Ah well, let me brief you on the plan, such as it is...

passages.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
passages.text:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

passages.title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
passages.text:
Dear Unadulterated Badass,

If you're reading this, you're exactly the sort of tough-as-nails champ in the making we need down at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.

You and two friends are cordially invited to fight for your lives against the toughest creatures this side of Gorgrond. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!

Come talk to me to start your first fight - beat four of the fiercest creatures I've got and you'll get a shot at the champ himself!

-Gurgthock

passages.title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
passages.text:
Two hundred gold... two hundred and fifty...

That makes it about three fifty. Not bad!

Oh, hey, what's shakin' champ?

passages.title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
passages.text:
You did it. You really did it! Here's your winnings, champ.

Man, the Highmaul ogres are not going to like this...

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text:
With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.

The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text: Dis be da blade dat Jones was lookin for?

passages.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
passages.text:
Excellent, mon! I be takin dis to Jones right away. 

Here be your reward.

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text:
Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible. 

The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text: Ya manage ta get da amulet?

passages.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
passages.text:
It's good we got dis and not da arakkoa.

Jones will be wantin dis, I'm sure.

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text:
With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir. 

Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.

His mask should bring a hefty reward.

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text: Dat must be da cursed skull you got dere.

passages.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
passages.text:
Dis be an odd mask for a Laughing Skull, to be sure. 

Jones left dis reward for ya.

passages.title: Commander in the Field!
passages.text:
We have been stopped by these new fel orcs, but we will ultimately prevail. Draka and I did manage to get a full scouting group out into the jungle to gather what else we will have to deal with.

You should seek them out, gain a full understanding of what we face here.

passages.title: Commander in the Field!
passages.text: We have quite a war on our hands. At least we do not lack for targets to strike!

passages.title: Gossip Test Case 1
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Gossip Test Case 2
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Gossip Test Case 3
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Greeting Text Test Case 1
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Greeting Text Test Case 2
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Greeting Text Test Case 3
passages.text: Quest Text.

passages.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
passages.text:
[PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. The scouts reported seeing strange rituals and beings of pure darkness. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!

If we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

passages.title: Get a Clue
passages.text:
Aktar mentioned that in the ruins he's seen Sethekk, ogres, even demons, but no sign of Iskar.

We're going to have to go in there if we're to find any clues and I'd prefer someone strong like yourself to lead the way.

Well, what do you say?

passages.title: Get a Clue
passages.text: The binding is dirty yet the pages are still in good condition. Upon the bottom of the binding is written "Property of Iskar."

passages.title: Get a Clue
passages.text: This tome looks like the one Iskar used to carry. What could have caused him to leave it?

passages.title: REUSE
REUSE
REUSE
Unearthed Magic
passages.text:
Commander, I've heard reports of a strange stone found in the garrison mine. The miners aren't sure what to make of it, but I have a feeling it could be useful.

When you next find yourself at the mine, it may be worth investigating. And if you don't mind, I would love to see the stone for myself.

passages.title: Unearthed Magic
passages.text: Greetings sir.  Have you found the stone?

passages.title: Unearthed Magic
passages.text:
So it's as I imagined, a battle-stone!

I've been able to collect similar stones here in Draenor, but never one this large!  A rare find indeed.

passages.title: Unearthed Magic
passages.text:
Commander, da miners be findin' somethin' in our mine with strong mojo. They don' be knowin' what ta do with it, so maybe you gonna go overe dere and check it out?

If you find it, bring it here so I can look closer at da magic.

passages.title: Unearthed Magic
passages.text: Where be the stone?

passages.title: Unearthed Magic
passages.text: Ah sure, I be findin' stones like this everywhere in Draenor, but never one dis big!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
passages.text:
Your garrison is in an uproar. King Varian Wrynn himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.

The King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
passages.text:
<The King is studying maps of Tanaan Jungle and the surrounding area.>

<name>! The Alliance owes you a great debt for establishing this garrison. Thanks to your bravery and commanding leadership, we've fought this war here on Draenor, instead of amongst our own homes and farmsteads.

It's time now to finish this. Are you ready for the final campaign?

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text:
Several orcs have spoken out since Gul'dan assumed control. Some were taken prisoner. Among them is an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." He designed these docks as well as the great dreadnaughts of the orcish fleet. If my scouts are right, he's in that prison train as we speak... And he may be ready to defect!

Gather explosives and meet with Yrel at the train to the southeast!

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text: Commander, it's you! Naielle promised she would send someone.

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text: Roark is definitely in this prisoner train but it's locked tight. We'll have to - oh - you brought explosives? Naielle thinks of everything! Let's crack this car open and see if we can convince that engineer to defect...

passages.title: The Train Gang
passages.text:
These rangari will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors.

I will try to talk Roark into joining our cause. He's a genius around a drydock and our best hope for building a shipyard.

If it doesn't work, we must be prepared to kill him. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding another Iron Fleet...

passages.title: The Train Gang
passages.text:
Lower your weapon, stranger. Blackhand is dead and our new "Warchief" just signed my death sentence. It looks like I'm going mercenary.

You want to build a shipyard? Then you want me.

passages.title: Nothing Remains
passages.text:
Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people.

You and your allies from Shattrath still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor!

Let your people know I am coming.

passages.title: Nothing Remains
passages.text: You found us a shipwright then? Good! Some of your followers are eager to take to the open seas.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text:
Let's put this "Iron Shipwright" of yours to work, commander. If we're to pull off your plan to assault Tanaan from both land and sea, we'll need to get some docks operational as soon as possible. Work with Roark and build the Alliance a shipyard!

Last I saw, Roark was northwest of the garrison, near Eventide Landing.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text: I'll need building materials, commander. You can't build docks from mud.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text:
<Roark scans the horizon.>

Yes, here. A good natural bay. The remains of that old warship can be gutted and turned into your first transport.

I see you've gathered all the materials we need. Are you ready?

passages.title: Friends Above
passages.text:
Iskar disappeared and now the Shadow Council is at our throats. These can't be unrelated events. We need to go to the last place he was seen, the ruins of Kra'nak.

I've asked a friend to set up a camp nearby. I say we head there to continue our search.

passages.title: Friends Above
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. You're just in time.

Aktar says the Shadow Council are teaching the Sethekk their vile ways. There are even a group of High Arakkoa that have joined the Shadow Council's banner!

I wonder how does Iskar factor into this?

passages.title: Friends Above
passages.text:
Iskar disappeared and now the Shadow Council is at our throats. These can't be unrelated events. We need to go to the last place he was seen, the ruins of Kra'nak.

I've asked a friend to set up a camp nearby. I say we head there to continue our search.

passages.title: Friends Above
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. You're just in time.

Aktar says the Shadow Council are teaching the Sethekk their vile ways. There are even a group of High Arakkoa that have joined the Shadow Council's banner!

I wonder how does Iskar factor into this?

passages.title: Finding the Killer
passages.text: With this map, you have pinpointed the origin of the attacks. It is time to see who or what is behind the attacks, and if they are a possible ally.

passages.title: Finding the Killer
passages.text: You... remember me? I came through the portal with you. I was called... Ariok. Before I became this.

passages.title: Following the Bloody Path
passages.text: The ones I kill... they speak of a cave. Sacred to the Bleeding Hollow. Kilrogg could be there - I am going.

passages.title: Following the Bloody Path
passages.text: Old earth... old blood. I smell Kilrogg. He has been here.

passages.title: The Bleeding Hollow
passages.text: The cave pulls me. It keeps angry spirits near. Kilrogg has done magic here. You help me understand...

passages.title: The Bleeding Hollow
passages.text:
You step on hallowed ground, invader. Here the chieftains of the Bleeding Hollow have performed rituals to see the future.

You should die but there is much at stake...

passages.title: Spirits of the Bleeding Hollow
passages.text:
It is clear the cave is protected by powerful ghosts, ancestors of the Bleeding Hollow.

Whatever is down there, it will be easier to deal with if many of the spirits were dealt with first.

passages.title: Mystery Notebook
passages.text: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but a few poor attempts at poetry center around the "radiant glow" of the Undercity and someone named Estelle Gendry.

passages.title: Mystery Notebook
passages.text:
<Estelle pages through the damaged tome and sighs wistfully.>

Oh dear, another paramour dead! Draenor has a terrible habit of eating my lovers alive.

passages.title: Mystery Notebook
passages.text: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but you can make out some sort of Ironforge-based drinking game scoring system involving a dwarf named Krom Stoutarm.

passages.title: Mystery Notebook
passages.text:
Oh now, this brings back some memories. Y'didn't look at the scores did you?

This belonged to ol' Nolan, may he rest in peace. Not a very good explorer, but a helluva drinker.

passages.title: Portable Portals
passages.text: My assistants have figured out how to convert ogre waystones into useful items for our garrison. Speak with Varsha outside to start your first work order.

passages.title: Portable Portals
passages.text: Did you find Varsha?

passages.title: Portable Portals
passages.text: I see you found Varsha.  Now, keep him supplied with waystones and we will be well on our way to defeating the iron horde.

passages.title: Portable Portals
passages.text: My assistants have figured out how to convert ogre waystones into useful items for our garrison. Speak with Apprentice Var'nath outside to start your first work order.

passages.title: Portable Portals
passages.text: I see you found Apprentice Var'nath.  Now, keep him supplied with waystones and we will be well on our way to defeating the iron horde.

passages.title: Fencing the Rose
passages.text:
Ah yes, an eternium rose.  I heard vendors suddenly stopped buying them... something about the resell value being too low.

You're in luck though, because I know a collector who still wants them.  In fact, I can take this one off your hands, but you'll have to come back tomorrow if you have another one to sell.

passages.title: New Goods
Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
passages.text: Your ally, Liadrin, has sent a missive requesting aid near Auchindoun. The Sargerei have made a new assault there and breached something important. It is no coincidence this happened after Gul'dan's ascendancy. We will watch the front here, commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
passages.text: I know the battle for Tanaan presses sorely on your forces commander. I am glad you came. The Sargerei and Gul'dan have the same masters, so this new attack likely affects you as well.

passages.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
passages.text:
The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun. They were never able to find a reason. Suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into a subchamber.

Corruption leaks from that hole, we need to stop it.

passages.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
passages.text: This is unfortunate. We cannot allow Gorefiend to aid Gul'dan's machinations. He must be slain once and for all.

passages.title: The Sargerei Menace
passages.text:
An attack such as this was unexpected. They have deployed heavily and it will take me some time to marshal enough forces to root them out.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
passages.text:
The Auchenai have sent me an urgent missive - Auchindoun is in jeopardy again! The Sargerei have renewed their assault and breached the underhalls. I sense the hand of Gul'dan is behind this.

Gather your things and meet me in the Court of Souls West of Auchindoun at once!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
passages.text: I am glad you came at once. Something terrible is brewing beneath this holy place.

passages.title: New Goods
The Invasion of Tanaan
passages.text:
It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here.

Now that we have our transport, we can let Yrel and Archmage Khadgar know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.

passages.title: The Invasion of Tanaan
passages.text: The landing was easier than I expected but there is trouble ahead.

passages.title: Obstacle Course
passages.text:
Our landing was unopposed. Why are these docks all but abandoned?

The rangari scouts up ahead report trouble. Bleeding Hollow scavengers are looting some abandoned buildings to the northwest, and an encampment of warlock cultists lurk near the Dark Portal. Let's find out what we can and meet up with our scouts.

passages.title: Obstacle Course
passages.text: Our forces can finish driving off the remaining lurkers. But there's another problem up ahead.

passages.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
passages.text:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

passages.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
passages.text:
Gul'dan seems to have concentrated his defenses on this chokepoint. The guns up ahead are unlike anything we've seen before - they're empowered with fel energy.

Our enemies think this pass is impregnable. Let's prove them wrong, commander! If we can break through, the terrain ahead will make an excellent stronghold. Destroy that cannon!

passages.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
passages.text: Don't worry, I have a taskforce coming in a bit to clean the rest up. We should move before their runners get back to Gul'dan.

passages.title: The Assault Base
passages.text:
While you were playing with fel fire, I've located the perfect position for an assault outpost.

Follow me and we can get this base started!

passages.title: The Assault Base
passages.text: The easy part is done, now comes the hard part.

passages.title: Commander in the Field!
passages.text:
This battle will be won, but it will be hard fought. Our rangari did manage to get a few scouts out to the rest of the jungle though.

Perhaps it is best you collect this intelligence yourself and see what this jungle holds for us all.

passages.title: Commander in the Field!
passages.text: There's a lot to see here isn't there?

passages.title: Commander in the Field!
passages.text: This will be a difficult campaign to be sure.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
passages.text:
Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.

It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.

You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
passages.text:
Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.

I suggest you speak with him immediately.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
passages.text:
I was too late to give you the message. I am truly sorry. These poor shaman... if only I had known sooner!

Gul'dan has prepared everything for his ritual. He will use the cipher and his own fel magic to corrupt an elemental lord and use it to sunder the elemental link to the land. This will cause a massive upheaval across Draenor!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
passages.text:
Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.

It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.

You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
passages.text:
Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.

I suggest you speak with him immediately.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
passages.text:
I was too late to give you the message. I am truly sorry. These poor shamans... if only I had known sooner!

Gul'dan has prepared everything for his ritual. He will use the cipher and his own fel magic to corrupt an elemental lord and use it to sunder the elemental link to the land. This will cause a massive upheaval across Draenor!

passages.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
passages.text:
The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun since Teron'gor's original assault. Now suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into one of the underhalls.

Corruption leaks from that breach. We must investigate!

passages.title: Secrets of the Sargerei
passages.text: More of my ancestors' souls plundered by Gorefiend! This must end once and for all. Gorefiend must be put down!

passages.title: The Sargerei Menace
passages.text:
This attack surprised our defenders. Forces are marshalling to push them out, but it will take some time for them to arrive.

Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
passages.text:
Your garrison is in an uproar. Warchief Vol'jin himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.

The Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
passages.text:
<The Warchief studies a map of Tanaan Jungle and its surroundings, his brow creased with worry.>

Ah, Commander <name>! Voice of da Horde in Draenor. Ya done well here, bringin' da fight ta our enemies. Thrall tells me ya exceed his every expectation.

It be time ta finish dis. Are ya ready?

passages.title: Clearing the Docks
passages.text:
We need to get control of this situation. We thought these docks would be all but abandoned. Instead, Gul'dan has ordered the Iron Horde to retreat to Tanaan, and many are using this harbor to make their getaway.

We need to clear a path for your salvage team. Lay waste to them! Every foe we slay here is one less convert for Gul'dan's wretched demon-worshipping army.

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text:
Some orcs have spoken out against Gul'dan, and they've been taken prisoner. One of them is what you'd call an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." This guy's good. Designed all these docks, as well as the big dreadnaughts you fought around Shattrath.

If my scouts are right, he's in a prison train as we speak... And I betcha he'd be willing to defect!

Gather up some explosives and meet Durotan next to the train to the south.

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text: Commander, it's you! Good, I need someone steady at my back.

passages.title: Derailment
passages.text:
We confirmed that Solog Roark is aboard this prison train, but it's locked up tight. Oh - you brought explosives? Hmph. Those goblin friends of yours are always prepared.

Let's bust this box open and convince that shipwright to join our cause...

passages.title: The Train Gang
passages.text:
My warriors will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors.

I will speak to Roark and convince him to defect to our cause. He built all of this - he's our best hope for building a shipyard of our own.

If this doesn't work, execute him on the spot. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding the Iron Fleet.

passages.title: The Train Gang
passages.text:
Lower your weapon, stranger. Blackhand is dead and our new "Warchief" just signed my death sentence. It looks like I'm going mercenary.

You want to build a shipyard? Then you want me.

passages.title: Nothing Remains
passages.text:
Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people.

You and your Frostwolf allies still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor!

Let your people know I am coming.

passages.title: Nothing Remains
passages.text: Ah, ya found us a shipwright? Good! Ya followers be eager ta take on da open seas.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text:
Let's put dis "Iron Shipwright" ta work, commander. If we ta take Tanaan from both land an' sea, we gonna need a shipyard. Work wit' Roark an' make it happen!

He be surveyin' tha land along tha road west of Frostwall.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text: I'll need building supplies, commander. Can't build docks of ice and snow.

passages.title: All Hands on Deck
passages.text:
<Solog Roark scans the horizon.>

This will do. It's a good deepwater harbor. We can gut that old warship down there to make your first transport. Moving supplies up and down these cliffs will be a chore, but they'll give us additional security in case we're attacked.

We'll make it work. Are you ready to get building?

passages.title: The Battle for the West
passages.text:
Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts.

I have received word that Durotan has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

passages.title: The Battle for the West
passages.text: Now you see what we face here. We will keep as much pressure here as we can so your base can remain free to attack all over the jungle.

passages.title: A Message of Terrible Import
passages.text:
Your scout... he got me out of that hellish place. Fel orcs surprised us out in the jungle and dragged us up the mountain. They tortured us... killed all but me. I fear one of us may have given up our secret before the end.

I must ask you to go to the home of our order. Speak with Lagar, my leader, tell him... tell him Gul'dan knows.

passages.title: A Message of Terrible Import
passages.text: This is most unfortunate.

passages.title: A Message of Terrible Import
passages.text: We will speak more of this later, but thank you.

passages.title: The Battle for the West
passages.text:
Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts.

I have received word that Exarch Maladaar has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

passages.title: The Battle for the West
passages.text: Now you see what we face here. We will keep as much pressure here as we can so your base can remain free to attack all over the jungle.

passages.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
passages.text:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Remember the first war, we know the destruction the legion can cause if they are unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(38587))

passages.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
passages.text:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(38588))
