passages.title: Infrastructure Improvements
passages.text:
<Sir/Ma'am>, we built a vehicle to take ya up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden but whenever we try a test flight the navigation system goes crazy!

In my expert opinion it's 'cause of that crazy demon magic the Iron Horde is playing around with up there.

If you could travel up there and place these telemetry beacons we can program the vehicle and give you a stable flight all the way up.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

passages.title: Infrastructure Improvements
passages.text:
Hey welcome back! The signal's coming in loud and clear and the ship's good to go!

When you're ready to head back up just take the rocket for the fastest ride on Draenor! We set it up over near Gargash.

passages.title: Setting the Signal
passages.text:
<Sir/Ma'am>, we built a vehicle to bypass the Horde camp and take you to the Throne of Kil'jaeden! There's one problem, the concentrated fel energy up there is causing the navigation system to go haywire!

I'll need you to place some sensors along the edge of the summit. With them in place we can stabilize the flight controls.

Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

passages.title: Setting the Signal
passages.text:
Welcome back!

We're getting a strong feed from those sensors! The crew locked the navigation system on to the signal and everything should be good to go!

We set the machine up next to Skyguard Thann.

passages.title: zzDEPRECATEDzz Fighting on the Front
passages.text: [TEMP] While you are here, maybe you could help out a little? Normally you'd get this at the objective map in Lion's Watch. Please help out here.

passages.title: Battle Hardened
passages.text: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

passages.title: Battle Hardened
passages.text: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

passages.title: Hero's Call: The Hinterlands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at the aviary in Aerie Peak.

Our new brothers in the Alliance need your help to fend off the aggressive Horde offensive in their beloved homeland. Travel north from the Arathi Highlands, through the dwarven mountain pass and follow the road northwest to Aerie Peak.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Equipment Blueprint: Bilge Pump
passages.text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

passages.title: Equipment Blueprint: Bilge Pump
passages.text: Those look like some equipment blueprints!

passages.title: Equipment Blueprint: Bilge Pump
passages.text: This is a blueprint for some high tech naval equipment.  I should be able to reverse engineer the plans and have this equipment available for you shortly!

passages.title: Silas' Secret Stash
passages.text:
A great Darkmoon prize do you now seek, but be ye warned, it is not for the meek.

Your very first clue to send you on this caper, you will find printed on the back of this paper.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Lorewalker Cho has sent word that several of your companions survived the conflict in the Jade Forest and have been moved to Kun-Lai Summit to seek healing.

They need your help if they are to survive!

To reach Kun-Lai Summit, travel to the Valley of the Four Winds and look for the Highroad Grummle that can be found at the base of the Veiled Stair along the northeastern border.

They can guide you the rest of the way.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Oh, you are a friend of Cho's? Welcome! Welcome!

I would serve you a banquet, but as you can see, we are in dire straights at the moment.

Say, would you be willing to lend us a hand?

passages.title: Your Orders, General?
passages.text:
General, your forces in Tanaan Jungle await your orders. Travel to the Planning Map there to issue your commands.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Your Orders, General?
passages.text: Lok'tar General. Your forces await your orders.

passages.title: Your Orders, General?
passages.text:
Exarch Yrel has sent word from Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle that your forces stand ready for their new orders.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Your Orders, General?
passages.text: Greetings General. Your forces await your orders on the Planning Table.

passages.title: We Don't Need No Library Card
passages.text:
If history is any indication, Gul'dan is training a whole generation of warlocks to marshal against us. If we act fast, we can stem the tide and make things easier on ourselves.

As you and your fellow heroes venture into the depths of the Hellfire Citadel, seek out Tomes of Chaos from Gul'dan's lieutenants.

They're dangerous, so don't read any of them. Not even the pictures.

<Khadgar shudders.>

ESPECIALLY the pictures.

passages.title: We Don't Need No Library Card
passages.text: What about those books, <name>?

passages.title: We Don't Need No Library Card
passages.text:
<Khadgar gingerly looks over the spine of each book as you hand it to him, growing more and more visibly disgusted.>

Will you look at these? This is like a set of encyclopedias for psychopaths.

passages.title: Cooking the Books
passages.text:
<name>, we've got to destroy these tomes. Many of them have actual tortured souls bound into the pages, so we can't just burn them. Cordana will know what to do.

Take these books to my tower in Zangarra and give them to Cordana. Let me know when the deed is done.

passages.title: Cooking the Books
passages.text:
<Khadgar smiles.>

So, how is Cordana doing? Is all well at my tower?

passages.title: Cooking the Books
passages.text:
<Khadgar's face falls as you describe your encounter at the tower.>

Cordana...? Oh no no no...She's been very distant lately. I just... I thought it was part of her stone-cold warden routine. I didn't realize...

Ah, <name>! You see? This is exactly what Gul'dan does. He finds our weakness and turns it against us. Be careful who you trust. Ah, Cordana!

Cordana.

passages.title: Darkness Incarnate
passages.text:
We have one final task before us, <name>. We must defeat Gul'dan and unravel his plans for this world.

I have no reward to offer you - I have given you everything I can.

Come. When you and your allies are ready, we march on Hellfire Citadel... and end this.

passages.title: Darkness Incarnate
passages.text: We must thwart Gul'dan!

passages.title: Darkness Incarnate
passages.text:
<Khadgar's face is ashen.>

Draenor is saved, <name>. But the Legion is more powerful than even I had imagined. And Gul'dan, that snake - he's still alive. Somewhere.

Stay here and celebrate with the others, <name>. You've earned it. But I will soon return to Azeroth to deal with this, and I hope you will join me there when the time comes.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text: Archmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text:
<The Archmage looks damp and uncomfortable.>

I apologize for the conditions here, <name>. I had no choice. I summoned this tower at the optimal confluence of arcane energies. My hope is to finish my work here before all my books get musty.

So then! Let's get to it.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text: Welcome back, my friend. We have much work to do.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: Follow the blazing star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: Follow the chill star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text: Welcome back, my friend. We have much work to do.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text:
Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

This will not take long.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text:
Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

This will not take long.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Be bold, <name>, and you may win many friends on this day.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Your new allies left this here, as a tribute for your efforts on their behalf.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: I trust your battles went well?

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: The wind whispers your name, <name>, and tales of your conquest.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: Well done, <name>. With courage, you have faced every challenge along the way, and battled to claim your rightful place.

passages.title: Blueprints Are Important
passages.text:
The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. Lucky for you, I snatched some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there. There is a one problem though...

These blueprints can get me in big trouble if the Iron Horde finds out. I need you to memorize them and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text:
The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there.

Let's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, <class>, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text: You memorize those blueprints yet?

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text: Hah, we'll make you a sea-dog yet. Let's get started on our first ship!

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text:
We have come a long way in a short time on this shipyard, <name>. Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor!

I will need to setup shop from a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions. Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started.

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text: Finish a naval mission yet?

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text: Great work Commander!  You are going to make a great captain one day.

passages.title: Command of the Seas
passages.text:
Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal.

We need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

passages.title: Command of the Seas
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. These docks are buzzing with activity.

Let's do some damage.

passages.title: Let's Get To Work
passages.text: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships! Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there? He said he had a plan.

passages.title: Let's Get To Work
passages.text: I love the smell of fresh-cut wood and tar! Are you ready to start construction?

passages.title: Slay Them All!
passages.text: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

passages.title: Slay Them All!
passages.text: Well done Commander! But there are still a lot of Horde out there wreaking havoc.

passages.title: An Even Bigga Score
passages.text: So these mooks in Tanaan, they be carryin' all manner of valuable treasures. It still be complicated, but I can give ya a lot more now!

passages.title: An Even Bigga Score
passages.text: So you've got every last one?

passages.title: An Even Bigga Score
passages.text: Eh, ya got dem all! Dat's wonderful for the both of us. I can give ya dis much...

passages.title: Beyond the Wall
passages.text:
We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion.

The pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?

passages.title: Beyond the Wall
passages.text: Welcome to Townlong Steppes. If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.

passages.title: Ill Tempered
passages.text: <Prying the lid off the scroll case reveals a plan by the Iron Horde to use large fish in the oceans around Draenor to interfere with Alliance and Horde naval power. Incredibly, the plan seems to have already worked on smaller sharks, but only up to a point.>

passages.title: Gems of the Apexis
passages.text:
Listen, boss. I know you're a jewelcrafter. It's OK, I totally understand - I like money, too!

I heard some of them bird fellas talking about some new gem-cuttin' device they got up in Tanaan. I'd be interested in checkin' it out myself, but I've got this whole shipyard mess to deal with right now.

passages.title: Gems of the Apexis
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Mastery Of Taladite
passages.text:
You - you are a gemcutter, no? You have the look of it in the twitch of your knuckles, in the focus of your eyes.

I've been looking for something specific out here in Tanaan. We did not find it in our excavations in Arak... but the Apexis did not only dwell in Arak.

What I am looking for is a storied Apexis construct that specialized in cutting gems. Be on the lookout, jewelcrafter. Such a marvel could benefit the both of us.

passages.title: Mastery Of Taladite
passages.text:
<The construct lies amidst rubble, in disrepair.>

<Judging by the tools on its manipulator arms, this construct does appear to be designed for gemwork.>

passages.title: Ruined Construct
passages.text:
<It is in disrepair, but it is not broken. More than anything, the construct appears to be in need of re-energizing.>

<A slot on the backside of the machine lies open, waiting to accept... whatever the Apexis used as a source of energy.>

passages.title: Ruined Construct
passages.text: Are you responsible for the return of this construct, <name>? It came barrelling through our camp like it was on a mission. It took three of the warders to tackle and subdue it, but for the time being, it appears content to stay here.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Zangarmarsh!
passages.text:
The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition. Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body.

The expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost. Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh. Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Zangarmarsh!
passages.text: Welcome to Cenarion Refuge, <name>.  I hope you've come to aid us in our mission.  We've much work ahead of us.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Zangarmarsh!
passages.text:
The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition. Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body.

The expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost. Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh. Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Zangarmarsh!
passages.text: Welcome to Cenarion Refuge, <name>.  I hope you've come to aid us in our mission.  We've much work ahead of us.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Terokkar Forest!
passages.text:
We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket

The Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.

The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Terokkar Forest!
passages.text:
I'm glad that Stonebreaker Hold sent you.  The druids of the thicket have been slain!  Only myself and one other have survived, and he's insane.

I don't know what happened, but I intend to get to the bottom of it.  Whatever it was, it happened quickly and feels unnatural.

Will you help me?

passages.title: Hero's Call: Terokkar Forest!
passages.text:
We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket

The King has commanded any able bodies of the Alliance to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.

The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Terokkar Forest!
passages.text:
I'm glad that Stonebreaker Hold sent you.  The druids of the thicket have been slain!  Only myself and one other have survived, and he's insane.

I don't know what happened, but I intend to get to the bottom of it.  Whatever it was, it happened quickly and feels unnatural.

Will you help me?

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
passages.text:
We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket

The Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened.

The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

passages.title: Hellfire Assault
passages.text:
If you are to breach the walls of the citadel, you must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.

I wish you luck in gaining entry to Hellfire Citadel with your limbs intact.

passages.title: Gems of the Apexis
passages.text:
Commander! I've noticed you have been keeping up with your jewelcrafting, despite all of this war going on. I find that to be most admirable.

I overheard some of the arakkoa discussing a gemcutting device that they believe is located within Tanaan Jungle. They got their information from one named "Chakkis."

Just thought you might be interested.

passages.title: Gems of the Apexis
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
passages.text:
The Warchief has asked for any able bodied champions of the Horde to ride to the aid of Garadar.

The home of the Mag'har, lies to the south, in Nagrand. Take the southern road out of the marsh, then turn east at the first fork and look for a large settlement on the lake.

Report to Captain Kroghan there and offer him what assistance you can. Garadar must not fall!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
passages.text:
<Even though he endeavors to hide it, a look of relief spreads over Kroghan's face.>

It's about time you got here! Granted, you're not an army, but any able-bodied <race> than can wield a weapon or chant a spell is welcome here. The people of Garadar are kin to all the Horde and we are proud to shed our blood in their defense.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
passages.text:
The King has requested you represent him with the Kurenai settlement of Telaar in Nagrand.

Seek out Warden Moi'bff Jill upon arrival.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
passages.text: You are welcome here in Telaar.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Blade's Edge Mountains!
passages.text:
The Alliance forces of Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains require reinforcements.

The King has asked for any able bodied members of the Alliance to journey to the mountains along the northern border of Zangarmarsh.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Blade's Edge Mountains!
passages.text: Thank you for coming. We could use more able bodies.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Netherstorm!
passages.text:
The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours.

The Warchief feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas.

Area 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Netherstorm!
passages.text: Hey there. Looking for work? Perfect!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Netherstorm!
passages.text:
The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours.

The King feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas.

Area 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Netherstorm!
passages.text: Hey there. Looking for work? Perfect!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dragonblight!
passages.text:
The Warchief wishes to reinforce the Horde's presence at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.

The fortress is a vital staging point for our assault on Icecrown and pivotal to containing the chaotic magic energies being released throughout the land.

Report to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dragonblight!
passages.text:
What took you so long? Time waits only for Aspects, <race>.

We have much work to do, you and I.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Dragonblight!
passages.text:
Volunteers are needed to aid the Silver Covenant forces in the Dragonblight as they attempt to counter the chaotic arcane energies that threaten to rip the land apart.

Those skilled in fighting dragons and undead are greatly welcome.

Those willing to answer the call should report to Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Dragonblight!
passages.text: I've been expecting you, <class>. We have much work to do, you and I.

passages.title: Zul'Drak
passages.text:
Our death knight allies in Zul'Drak are in need of heroes to aid them in securing the troll lands from the Scourge.

Those willing to aid should travel to the southwestern camp of Ebon Watch and speak with Stefan Vadu there.

passages.title: Zul'Drak
passages.text: What have you got there, <race>?

passages.title: Zul'Drak
passages.text:
<Stefan reads the missive, then crumples it up and tosses it into the fire.>

Old news. The Argent Crusade is - once again - late to the party. We've been tracking Drakuru since Grizzly Hills. He is slated for eradication.

passages.title: Sholazar Basin
passages.text:
Hemet Nesingwary was last heard from leading an expedition into the jungle depths of Sholazar Basin. His expedition has not been heard from since.

Monte Muzzleshot is a pilot who was dispatched to provide them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either.

Volunteers are needed to mount an expedition to find the missing expedition. Monte's flying machine was last seen in the Wildgrowth Mangal south of the Suntouched Pillar in Sholazar Basin.

passages.title: Sholazar Basin
passages.text: Aye, Hemet's here. He's at the camp, just go northwest toward the river and you'll soon see it. And for the love of the Light, lad, have him send someone to cut me down!

passages.title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
passages.text:
The Kirin Tor have moved their city here to Northrend.

No longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest.

They believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Look for the teleportation crystal in Crystal Song Forest.

When you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra.

passages.title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
passages.text: Welcome to Dalaran.

passages.title: The Iron Bulwark
passages.text:
The Siegemaster within Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.

With any luck, she has not yet completed its construction, but you know what happens when we rely on luck...

passages.title: Pits of Mannoroth
passages.text:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they work to corrupt a magnaron with fel energy within the Pits of Mannoroth.

If you delve into the fel pools of that place, be on your guard.

passages.title: Pits of Mannoroth
passages.text: I wonder if dat magnaron fel into da pool. Get it, mon?

passages.title: Deadeye's Vision
passages.text:
Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.

Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death--or yours--in Hellfire Citadel.

passages.title: Maw of Souls
passages.text:
Falling into the heart of the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds of draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

passages.title: Maw of Souls
passages.text: I wouldn't know dat monster started off as an orc if Saurfang hadn't told me.

passages.title: Iskar's Clutch
passages.text:
I'm afraid I have bad news about someone we once trusted. The arakkoa known as Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.

With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at your hands.

passages.title: Temple of Tyranny
passages.text:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

passages.title: Temple of Tyranny
passages.text: Anotha follower of da darkness falls before ya.

passages.title: Grommash's Torment
passages.text:
We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered to him.

But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dan's best-known torturer.

I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.

passages.title: The Felborne Breach
passages.text:
Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths of the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one of most powerful of the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes of reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.

Gul'dan has twisted Xhul'horac, feeding him overwhelming fel energy, and using his powers to tear open the portals through which he plans to rally the forces of the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Destructor's Rise
passages.text:
We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we had predicted.

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

passages.title: Destructor's Rise
passages.text: Dat bag of bones be gone again.

passages.title: The Black Gate
passages.text:
We have heard rumors that one of the strongest of the eredar could soon enter this world through the Black Gate.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. Should he arrive uncontested, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

passages.title: The Black Gate
passages.text: Ya saved Draenor from one of da strongest demons in all creation, Commander. Dey will sing songs of your victory.

passages.title: Let's Get To Work
passages.text: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships! Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there? He said he had a plan.

passages.title: Let's Get To Work
passages.text: I love the smell of fresh-cut wood and tar! Are you ready to start construction?

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text:
The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there.

Let's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, <class>, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text: You memorize those blueprints yet?

passages.title: Shipbuilding
passages.text: Hah, we'll make you a sea-dog yet. Let's get started on our first ship!

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text:
You're a natural at this, <name>. You've got the salt in your veins. Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor!

You will want a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions. I know a good spot just up the path behind us. Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started on our first mission.

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text: Finish a naval mission yet?

passages.title: Naval Commander
passages.text: Great work Commander!  You are going to make a great captain one day.

passages.title: Hellfire Assault
passages.text:
If ye want to breach the walls o' the citadel, ye must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.

Good luck gainin' entry to Hellfire Citadel with yer limbs intact.

passages.title: The Iron Bulwark
passages.text:
The Siegemaster in Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.

With any luck, she hasn't yet completed its construction, but ye know what happens when we rely on luck...

passages.title: Pits of Mannoroth
passages.text:
In the Hellfire Citadel, they're corruptin' a magnaron with fel energy in the Pits o' Mannoroth.

If ye delve into the fel pools of that place, be on yer guard.

passages.title: Pits of Mannoroth
passages.text: We can't handle too many more of those fel-corrupted beasts.

passages.title: Deadeye's Vision
passages.text:
Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.

Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death at yer hands in Hellfire Citadel.

passages.title: Maw of Souls
passages.text:
Falling into the heart o' the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds o' draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process. 

No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

passages.title: Maw of Souls
passages.text: I hope you make Gorefiend pay for his atrocities.

passages.title: Maw of Souls
passages.text: That was some kind of monster, wasn't it?

passages.title: Iskar's Clutch
passages.text:
I'm afraid I have bad news about someone ye once trusted. The arakkoa Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.

With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at yer hands.

passages.title: Temple of Tyranny
passages.text:
Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.

Purge this Eredar of darkness.

passages.title: Temple of Tyranny
passages.text: How does a vindicator fall so far from the light?

passages.title: Grommash's Torment
passages.text:
We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered him.

But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dans best-known torturer.

I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.

passages.title: The Felborne Breach
passages.text:
Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths o' the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one o' the most powerful o' the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes o' reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.

Gul'dan has twisted Xhul'horac, feeding him overwhelming fel energy, and using his powers to tear open the portals through which he plans to rally the forces o' the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Destructor's Rise
passages.text:
We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we thought.

Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

passages.title: Destructor's Rise
passages.text: Let's hope Mannoroth stays down longer this time.

passages.title: The Black Gate
passages.text:
We've heard rumors that one o' the strongest eredar might enter this world through the Black Gate soon.

If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. If he arrives unchallenged, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

passages.title: The Black Gate
passages.text: You have saved Draenor from one of the strongest demons in all creation, Commander. They will sing songs of your victory.

passages.title: Strange Tools
passages.text:
We are well on our way to building our first ship, but unfortunately, I am not the orc for the job. I have no idea how to work with these human tools. Your shipwright, Yanas Seastrike, is going to take over from here on out.

I will be here at the dry docks if you need anything from me.

passages.title: Strange Tools
passages.text: Interested in shipbuilding, I see?  I will do everything I can to help out, commander.

passages.title: The Missing Manifest
passages.text:
The water-proofed manifest contains some form of code for the most part, hiding the contents of the actual manifest. In the corner is a hastily scrawled note for a Mr. Knuckles. "Shipment attacked, got away but boat is sinking. Get here before they do."

There are coordinates after that which lead to the sunken boat. Mr. Knuckles is definitely the kind of person you want owing you a favor, not the other way around.

passages.title: The Missing Manifest
passages.text: Whatchoo got there?

passages.title: The Missing Manifest
passages.text:
Dis... is important! Where you find dis? We been lookin for dis stuff a while.

You got a dock now? Dat is VERY interesting. Maybe it time we became good friends? Da big fort you have is hard to sneak a spy-- er, forget I said dat.

I gots an idea.

passages.title: Black Marketeering
passages.text:
Ya did us a real solid today, <name>. Boss Goya says you're big stuff in dese parts and we should keep an eye on --- uh, I mean we should be good buds. She's sent a repre... repre... del-e-g... um, a Black Market person to your garrison.

Go say hi and stuff, and make sure to speak loudly when you plan what you're gonna do next.

passages.title: Black Marketeering
passages.text:
I am pleased to make your acquaintance, commander. If you ever wish to see the latest wonders that Madame Goya offers, please do not hesitate to speak with me. She sends this as a token of appreciation for your work in retrieving the manifest.

Remember, Madame Goya only accepts bids in person. You must travel to meet her, if you wish to acquire any of her wares.

passages.title: Bring the Reinforcements
passages.text:
Greetings, Commander! With all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got the breathing room to divert some of our resources from nearby outposts to help make headway.

Just let me know which reinforcements to call, and I'll get them here on the double!

passages.title: Bring the Reinforcements
passages.text: Which allies should I call for?

passages.title: Bring the Reinforcements
passages.text: Great! I'm always here if ye' ever want to change your mind!

passages.title: Bring the Reinforcements
passages.text:
Hey there, Commander. You know, with all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got plenty of extra supplies just sitting around in our nearby outposts.

You just give me the order and I'll make sure some of them get sent our way!

passages.title: Bring the Reinforcements
passages.text:
A whole slew of artillery options at your hands! Living the dream.

Remember, you can return to me at any time if you change your mind!

passages.text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

passages.title: Equipment Blueprint: Trained Shark Tank
passages.text: Those look like some equipment blueprints!

passages.title: Equipment Blueprint: Trained Shark Tank
passages.text: This is a blueprint for some high tech naval equipment.  I should be able to reverse engineer the plans and have this equipment available for you shortly!

passages.title: The Cipher of Damnation
passages.text:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

passages.title: The Cipher of Damnation
passages.text:
You have saved us all. The Cipher has become fragmented with Cyrukh's death. This means its guardians can hide the shards all over Draenor so the chances of piecing it together will be impossible.

This great victory will give us more time to stop Gul'dan but I shudder to think of what his next plan may be...

passages.title: NOT USED
passages.text:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

passages.title: Shipyard Report
passages.text: Commander! We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious. Can you head back to Lunarfall and check in with Merreck? Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

passages.title: Shipyard Report
passages.text: We have been waiting for you, Commander.

passages.title: Shipyard Report
passages.text: Commander! We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious. Can you head back to Frostwall and check in with Rolosh? Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

passages.title: Shipyard Report
passages.text: We have been waiting for you, Commander.

passages.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
passages.text:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

passages.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
passages.text:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text:
Look to the north, <class>. The sky is turning a sickly green. Gul'dan's summoning portals are not yet at full strength, but already the stench of demon is on the wind.

Slay them, <name>. Destroy as many beasts as you can before they find a way to Azeroth. The Temple of Sha'naar is infested, as is the Throne of Kil'jaeden, although you may find others wandering about the jungle.

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text: How many demons were slain by your capable hands?

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text: How does it feel, <name>? To look the Burning Legion directly in the eye and to tell them... "Not today."

passages.title: Ashran Dominance
passages.text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

passages.title: Ashran Dominance
passages.text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

passages.title: Slay Them All!
passages.text: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

passages.title: Slay Them All!
passages.text: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

passages.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
passages.text:
Ever since the fall of Blackrock Foundry, Gul'dan has been turning the Iron Horde into... something worse. The orcs who once flocked to Grommash's banner, through either fear or thirst for revenge, are now embracing the fel.

Wade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to Gul'dan's forces. Orc or fel orc makes no difference. Gut what remains of the Iron Horde!

passages.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
passages.text: Feel no remorse for the fallen, <name>. They made their choice.

passages.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
passages.text: You gave them the glorious death they craved, <name>. Soon Gul'dan will have no one left to do his dirty work.

passages.title: Rumble in the Jungle
passages.text:
Dem fancy cat-men gotta be shown who is da boss 'round dese parts. Kill all their champions, and ya will earn da respect of all creatures in da jungle.

Y'gonna need dese totems to draw dem out.

passages.title: Rumble in the Jungle
passages.text: No lie mon - if I'd had money on you coming back in one piece, I'd be out that money right now.

passages.title: Rumble in the Jungle
passages.text: Ya done good, mon. We gotta keep up da pressure.

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text:
Demons! Hate 'em!

Gul'dan is spinning up more summoning portals with each passing hour. There's only one way to stem the tide, <name>.

<Parvink smashes her gauntleted fist against her open palm.>

Smash 'em!

The Temple of Sha'naar is a good place to start, or head up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden if you're looking for a real challenge.

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text:
<Parvink looks at some hatch marks she scribbled on a scrap of paper.>

I'm up to 17 demons killed today. You?

passages.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
passages.text: Nice! You're quite the slayer, <name>. Gimmie a low-five!

passages.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
passages.text:
Ever since we humiliated 'em at Blackrock Foundry, the Iron Horde has been on the run. Gul'dan is converting them all into fel orcs, but I ain't scared. A bloodlusting orc is twice as strong but twice as stupid.

Hey! Let's wade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to as many orcs as we can. Orc or fel orc - doesn't matter to me.

passages.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
passages.text:
<You and Parvink compare stories of your battles throughout the jungle. Finally, she hollers:>

GLORY TO THE ALLIANCE!!

<...Loud enough to frighten birds from the trees.>

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Alliance faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships. Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text: Any luck with those battleship plans?

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text: I look forward to seeing your impressive fleet of battleships, commander.

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Horde faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships. Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text: Any luck with those battleship plans?

passages.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
passages.text: I look forward to seeing your impressive fleet of battleships, commander.

passages.title: Where Are the Children?
passages.text:
The children have gone missing!

That horrible Grumpus has been making his way throughout Draenor, snatching up children. Please save them!

Our scouts have spotted him over in Frostfire Ridge.

passages.title: Where Are the Children?
passages.text: Thank you for all the help! Their families will be so happy to see them.

passages.title: Where Are the Children?
passages.text: Thank you for all the help! Their families will be so happy to see them.

passages.title: Menacing Grumplings
passages.text:
The grumplings are horrid creatures. They're the ones doin' the dirty work for Grumpus.

If you're able to remove the threat I'm sure rescuing the children won't be much of a problem.

passages.title: Menacing Grumplings
passages.text:
Well that was fast! Grumpus is gonna have a hard time continuing his work without his minions.

Take these. I had them specially crafted to withstand any climate.

You never know what you'll run into out here in Draenor!

passages.title: Menacing Grumplings
passages.text:
Well that was fast! Grumpus is gonna have a hard time continuing his work without his minions.

Take these. I had them specially crafted for ya.

You never know what you'll run into out here in Draenor!

passages.title: Grumpus
passages.text:
One of Draenor's oldest stories is the legend of Grumpus.

The story tells of a mean-spirited brute that would come in the night, in the dead of winter, and kidnap children that misbehaved. Back at his lair, he would present them with awful toys, and use their tears to spawn his minions.

But Grumpus is no legend, he's real and he's taken our children! Please, you have to slay him!

passages.title: Grumpus
passages.text:
Thanks, <name>. I couldn't have done it without you.

Take these as a token of my appreciation.

Happy holidays!

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war. Find Salty Jorren down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Equipment can really make a difference out there, let's see what I can do to help ya out.

passages.title: What Horrible Presents!
passages.text:
That mean old Grumpus has amassed a collection of odd gifts. He's deliberately trying to crush the spirit of children everywhere by giving out the worst presents imaginable.

Take this spirit bomb. Toss it on some of Grumpus's unusual gifts and take them out for good!

We're in this together, <name>. Now go and save the spirit of the holiday!

passages.title: What Horrible Presents!
passages.text: Wow. Those were some nasty presents. You might want to, uh... wash up. Who knows what those were made of.

passages.title: What Horrible Presents!
passages.text: Wow. Those were some nasty presents. You might want to, uh... wash up. Who knows what was inside some of those packages.

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war. Find Kronk Rustspark down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Find Kronk?

passages.title: Equipping Our Fleet
passages.text: Equipment can really make a difference out there, let's see what I can do to help ya out.

passages.title: Where Are the Children?
passages.text:
The children have gone missing!

That horrible Grumpus has been making his way throughout Draenor, snatching up children. Please save them!

Our scouts have spotted him over in Frostfire Ridge.

passages.title: Menacing Grumplings
passages.text:
The grumplings are horrid creatures. They're the ones doin' the dirty work for Grumpus.

If you're able to remove the threat I'm sure rescuing the children won't be much of a problem.

passages.title: Smashing Squashlings
passages.text:
The Bonefleet once raided trading ships traveling the waters of Draenor. One such ship carried farming supplies intended for Elodor.

Now, they use these supplies to sow their plague into our earth. From the putrid mounds sprout vegetative horrors. These abominations must be destroyed, before they can spread across the landscape.

passages.title: Smashing Squashlings
passages.text: I bet it felt great to smash those things! Smash, squish, squash!

passages.title: Mutiny on the Boneship
passages.text:
Each year, around this time, there is a strange surge of spiritual energy across Draenor. Beckoned by this phenomenon, a ghastly fleet of undead pirates emerges from the mist. We call it the Bonefleet.

The Bonefleet is led by a savage pirate known as Bonerender. He seeks nothing more than the complete destruction of all of the living of Draenor.

Seek out Bonerender and defeat him, before he sails back into the mist once again.

passages.title: Mutiny on the Boneship
passages.text: Finally, he's returned to the briny deep. I'm sure we'll see him again, but for now let's celebrate!

passages.title: Foul Fertilizer
passages.text:
The Bonefleet wants nothing more than to spread their undead curse onto dry land. Like a sickness, it will slowly overtake the landscape if left unchecked.

The stench of undeath permeates the barrels of fertilizer they use to sow their dread crops. They are the source of the spreading plague, and must be destroyed.

passages.title: Foul Fertilizer
passages.text: Thinking what goes into normal fertilizer, I don't even want to know what was in THAT stuff.

passages.title: Culling the Crew
passages.text:
If we're going to protect Draenor from the Bonefleet menace, we'll need to thin out the crew.

See to a swift reduction in their numbers, and we might just push them back into the sea for another year.

passages.title: Culling the Crew
passages.text: We're lucky you were around to take care of those bony brutes!

passages.title: Abrogator Arbitrator
passages.text: Da bums in Highmaul refuse to see dey are on da way out. Me, I'm gettin' while da gettin' is good. Da sooner youse bring me a bunch of Apexis Crystals, da sooner I can get off dis stupid island. Da amount required is very precise!

passages.title: Abrogator Arbitrator
passages.text: I can feel da power of da crystals! Give dem to me!

passages.title: Abrogator Arbitrator
passages.text:
Finally! Today is da day I can get out of here!

If not I'll need more of dem to try again.

passages.title: Work Work Stoppage
passages.text:
We've had enough! The working conditions in the Foundry are intolerable with all the fire and the ogron and the flames and the fire elementals and infernos and marauding adventurers! But especially the heat.

I've had enough! Me and the boys are going to start a work stoppage but we need to hire some security muscle and the only goon from Highmaul I could get to agree to the job only takes payment in Apexis Crystals.

passages.title: Work Work Stoppage
passages.text: It's a good thing you took care of Mar'gok or nobody would be available for hire. Ogre security is still effective, right?

passages.title: Work Work Stoppage
passages.text: I'd say thanks, but I'm pretty sure that us shutting down the Foundry helps you out more than it helps us. So you're welcome.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Warlords
passages.text:
You have proven yourself before but the wilds of Draenor are on another level. Defeat tamers in the wilds to prove your pet battle supremacy: Cymre Brightblade in Gorgrond, Vesharr in Spires of Arak, Tarr the Terrible in Nagrand, Taralune in Talador, Gargra in Frostfire Ridge, or Ashlei in Shadowmoon Valley. You can also defeat a visiting tamer: Erris the Collector or Kura Thunderhoof in your garrison.

By defeating them will show your dominance in Draenor.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Warlords
passages.text: Have you been able to defeat most of the tamers?

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Warlords
passages.text: Your dominance of the pet battlers of Draenor are unmatched. You are now better prepared to challenge other heroes like yourself.

passages.title: To Tanaan!
passages.text:
It is vital that you set your focus on Tanaan Jungle and establish a foothold there, before you are distracted with other matters.

The Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting....

passages.title: To Tanaan!
passages.text:
<The Warchief studies a map of Tanaan Jungle and its surroundings, his brow creased with worry.>

Ah, Commander <name>! Voice of da Horde in Draenor. Ya done well here, bringin' da fight ta our enemies. Thrall tells me ya exceed his every expectation.

It be time ta finish dis. Are ya ready?

passages.title: To Tanaan!
passages.text:
It is vital that you set your focus on Tanaan Jungle and establish a foothold there, before you are distracted with other matters.

The King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

passages.title: To Tanaan!
passages.text:
<The King is studying maps of Tanaan Jungle and the surrounding area.>

<name>! The Alliance owes you a great debt for establishing this garrison. Thanks to your bravery and commanding leadership, we've fought this war here on Draenor, instead of amongst our own homes and farmsteads.

It's time now to finish this. Are you ready for the final campaign?

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: Follow the Destroyer's star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.
